title: Smoked Salmon, Avocado & Dill Whole Wheat Bagel
ingredients_json: ["1 piece Bagel, whole wheat", "30 g Cream cheese, light, plain", "50 g Salmon, smoked", "50 g Avocado, raw", "30 g Cucumber, fresh", "5 g Dill, fresh, chopped", "5 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "1 g Pepper, black, ground"]
instructions: Begin by toasting the whole wheat bagel to your desired crispness. While the bagel is toasting, thinly slice the cucumber and avocado. Once the bagel is ready, spread the light cream cheese evenly over both halves. Layer the smoked salmon over the cream cheese on the bottom half of the bagel. Arrange the sliced avocado and cucumber on top of the salmon. Sprinkle the fresh chopped dill over the ingredients. Drizzle with fresh lemon juice and season with a pinch of black pepper. Place the top half of the bagel on to complete your healthy breakfast.

Assemble the bagel halves and serve immediately.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Banana Walnut Bread
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Banana, ripe, raw", "250 g Flour, whole wheat", "2 piece Egg, raw", "60 ml Maple syrup", "60 ml Olive oil", "120 ml Milk, low fat, 1.5% fat", "5 g Baking soda", "2 g Salt, table", "3 g Cinnamon, ground", "80 g Walnuts, raw, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees Celsius and lightly grease a standard loaf pan. In a large bowl, mash the ripe bananas thoroughly with a fork. To the mashed bananas, add the eggs, maple syrup, and olive oil, mixing well until thoroughly combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, baking soda, salt, and ground cinnamon. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined; be careful not to overmix, as this can lead to a tough bread. Fold in the chopped walnuts gently. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and spread evenly. Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. If the top starts to brown too quickly, you can loosely tent it with aluminum foil. Let the banana bread cool in the pan for 10-15 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing and serving.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Banana Nut Bread with Oats

title: Wholesome Maple Walnut Banana Bread
ingredients_json: ["3 medium Bananas, ripe, mashed", "200 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Oats, rolled, dry", "1 piece Egg, large", "60 ml Maple syrup", "60 ml Olive oil", "60 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "100 g Walnuts, chopped", "1 tsp Baking soda", "0.5 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]

title: Hearty Whole Wheat Oat Buttermilk Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat flour, fine", "50 g Rolled oats, dry", "15 g Baking powder, double acting", "3 g Baking soda", "5 g Salt, table", "30 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "240 ml Buttermilk, low fat (1.5% fat)", "10 ml Honey, liquid"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Cut the cold unsalted butter into small cubes, then use a pastry blender, two knives, or your fingertips to cut the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, low-fat buttermilk, and honey. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix with a spoon until just combined; be careful not to overmix, as this can make the biscuits tough. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Gently pat the dough into a roughly 2 cm (¾ inch) thick rectangle. Fold the dough in half, then gently pat it out again. Repeat this folding and patting process 2-3 times to create flaky layers. Use a 6 cm (2.5 inch) round cutter to cut out the biscuits, pressing straight down without twisting. Reroll scraps gently as needed, taking care not to overwork the dough. Place the biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the tops are golden brown and puffed. Serve warm.

title: Wholesome Honey-Oat Buttermilk Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Oat flour", "10 g Baking powder", "2 g Baking soda", "3 g Salt, table", "60 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "180 ml Buttermilk, low fat", "15 g Honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, oat flour, baking powder, baking soda, and table salt until well combined. Cut the cold unsalted butter into small cubes and add it to the dry ingredients. Using a pastry blender or your fingertips, work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the low-fat buttermilk and honey. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently with a fork just until a shaggy dough forms; be careful not to overmix. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Gently pat the dough into a disc approximately 2.5 cm (1 inch) thick. Using a 6 cm (2.5 inch) round biscuit cutter, cut out the biscuits. Gather and gently re-roll any scraps once to cut out additional biscuits. Place the biscuits on the prepared baking sheet, leaving a small space between each. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the tops are golden brown and the biscuits are cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Buttermilk Biscuits with Chia Seeds

title: Savory Whole Wheat & Oat Biscuits with Fresh Chives
ingredients_json: ["200 g Wheat flour, whole grain", "50 g Rolled oats", "8 g Baking powder", "2 g Baking soda", "3 g Salt, table", "40 g Butter, unsalted", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "50 ml Milk, low fat", "15 g Chives, fresh, chopped"]

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Ricotta Blintzes with Blueberry-Lemon Compote
ingredients_json: ["100 g Flour, whole wheat", "2 piece Egg, raw, whole", "250 ml Milk, low-fat (1% fat)", "5 g Sugar, white, granulated", "2 ml Vanilla extract", "2 g Salt, table", "5 ml Olive oil", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim (10-15% fat)", "15 g Sugar, white, granulated", "2 g Lemon zest, fresh", "200 g Blueberries, fresh", "10 g Sugar, white, granulated", "30 ml Water", "2 ml Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions:
Begin by preparing the crepe batter. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, two raw eggs, 250 ml of low-fat milk, 5 grams of sugar, 2 ml of vanilla extract, and 2 grams of salt until smooth and lump-free. Let the batter rest for at least 15 minutes. Heat a non-stick pan (approximately 20 cm diameter) over medium heat and lightly brush with olive oil. Pour about 60-70 ml of batter into the pan, tilting quickly to coat the bottom evenly. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges are golden and the center is set, then carefully flip and cook for another 30 seconds. Transfer cooked crepes to a plate and stack them, separating with parchment paper if desired, to prevent sticking. Repeat until all batter is used, yielding about 6-7 crepes.

Next, prepare the filling. In a medium bowl, combine the 250 grams of part-skim ricotta cheese, 15 grams of sugar, the remaining 2 ml of vanilla extract, and the fresh lemon zest. Mix until well combined.

To assemble the blintzes, lay one crepe flat on a clean surface. Place about 2-3 tablespoons of the ricotta filling near one edge. Fold the sides of the crepe over the filling, then roll it up tightly from the filled edge to form a neat package. Repeat with the remaining crepes and filling.

Heat a clean non-stick pan over medium heat with a tiny amount of olive oil if needed. Place the assembled blintzes seam-side down in the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and heated through.

While the blintzes are cooking, prepare the blueberry compote. In a small saucepan, combine the 200 grams of fresh blueberries, 10 grams of sugar, and 30 ml of water. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the berries soften and the sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the 2 ml of fresh lemon juice at the end.

Serve the warm blintzes immediately, topped with a generous spoonful of the blueberry-lemon compote.

title: Whole Wheat Ricotta Blintzes with Strawberry-Blueberry Compote
ingredients_json: ["100 g Whole wheat flour", "2 piece Egg, raw", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "50 ml Water, tap", "5 ml Olive oil", "1 g Salt, table", "250 g Ricotta cheese, low fat", "15 ml Honey, unspecified", "2 ml Vanilla extract, pure", "2 g Lemon peel, grated", "150 g Strawberries, fresh", "75 g Blueberries, fresh", "10 ml Water, tap", "5 ml Maple syrup, pure"]
instructions: First, prepare the crepe batter. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, eggs, milk, 50 ml water, and salt until smooth. Let the batter rest for 15-20 minutes. While the batter rests, make the filling. In another bowl, combine the low-fat ricotta cheese, honey, vanilla extract, and grated lemon peel; mix well and set aside. Next, prepare the berry compote. In a small saucepan, combine the sliced strawberries, blueberries, 10 ml water, and maple syrup. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the berries soften slightly and release their juices. Remove from heat. To cook the crepes, heat a non-stick pan (about 20 cm diameter) over medium heat. Lightly brush with olive oil for the first crepe. Pour about 60-70 ml of batter into the hot pan, swirling to coat the bottom evenly. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges are golden and the surface appears dry. Flip and cook for another 30 seconds. Repeat with the remaining batter, stacking the cooked crepes on a plate. To assemble the blintzes, lay a crepe cooked-side up on a clean surface. Place about 2 tablespoons of the ricotta filling near one edge. Fold that edge over the filling, then fold in the sides, and roll it up into a neat package. Repeat with all crepes. Finally, you can gently pan-fry the assembled blintzes in a lightly oiled pan for a minute or two per side until warmed through and slightly golden, or serve them as is. Serve warm with the prepared strawberry-blueberry compote.

title: Whole Wheat Ricotta Blintzes with Warm Berry Compote
ingredients_json: ["60 g Whole wheat flour", "1 piece Egg, raw", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "50 ml Water, tap", "5 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 g Salt, table", "200 g Ricotta cheese, low-fat", "50 g Yogurt, Greek, plain, 0% fat", "10 ml Maple syrup", "2 ml Vanilla extract", "1 g Lemon zest, fresh", "150 g Mixed berries, frozen", "5 ml Maple syrup", "30 ml Water, tap"]

title: Whole Wheat Ricotta Blintzes with Berry Compote

title: Hearty Black Bean and Spinach Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Tortilla, whole wheat", "4 pieces Egg, raw", "100 g Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Bell pepper, red, chopped", "30 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "5 g Olive oil", "30 g Cheese, Cheddar, reduced fat, shredded", "75 g Avocado, raw", "60 g Salsa, tomato based", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: To begin, heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and red bell pepper and sauté for about 5-7 minutes until softened. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook until it wilts, approximately 2 minutes. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with salt and pepper. Pour the whisked eggs into the pan with the vegetables and scramble until cooked through but still moist, breaking them up with a spatula. Warm the whole wheat tortillas according to package instructions, either in a microwave, dry pan, or oven, until they are pliable. Lay each warm tortilla flat on a clean surface. Divide the scrambled egg and vegetable mixture evenly between the two tortillas, placing it slightly off-center towards one edge. Top with the drained black beans, shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese, evenly sliced avocado, and a generous dollop of salsa. Fold in the sides of each tortilla about 2-3 cm, then tightly roll them up from the bottom, creating two compact burritos. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Hearty Spinach and Black Bean Breakfast Burritos with Avocado
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Egg, raw", "2 pieces Tortilla, whole wheat", "100 g Black beans, canned, drained, rinsed", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Onion, yellow", "10 g Garlic, raw", "5 ml Olive oil", "50 g Avocado, raw", "2 g Cumin, ground", "1 g Chilli powder", "0.5 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Finely dice the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened and translucent. Stir in the minced garlic, ground cumin, and chilli powder, cooking for another minute until fragrant. Add the fresh spinach to the pan and cook until it wilts completely, about 2-3 minutes. Set the vegetable mixture aside in a bowl. In the same pan, whisk the raw eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper, then scramble them over medium heat until cooked through to your preferred consistency. Warm the whole wheat tortillas in a separate dry pan or microwave for about 15-20 seconds each until pliable. To assemble the burritos, spread an equal amount of the scrambled eggs onto the center of each warm tortilla. Top with the cooked spinach and onion mixture, then add the rinsed black beans and sliced avocado. Carefully fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll it up tightly from the bottom to create a compact burrito. Serve immediately and enjoy your healthy breakfast!

title: Healthy Turkey Sausage and Veggie Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["120 g Tortilla, whole wheat", "100 g Turkey mince, lean", "2 pieces Egg, raw, large", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Bell pepper, red, fresh", "25 g Onion, white, fresh", "15 ml Olive oil", "20 g Cheddar cheese, light, grated", "50 g Avocado, fresh", "1 g Paprika powder", "0.5 g Cumin powder", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "0.5 g Salt"]
instructions: Begin by finely chopping the onion and red bell pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the pan and sauté for 5 to 7 minutes until they have softened and become translucent. Next, add the lean turkey mince to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks. Continue to cook until the turkey is fully browned and cooked through, which should take approximately 5 to 8 minutes. Season the turkey and vegetables with paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine the flavors. Add the fresh spinach to the pan and cook for just 1 to 2 minutes until it has wilted. In a separate bowl, lightly whisk the eggs. Pour the whisked eggs directly into the pan with the turkey and vegetable mixture. Scramble the eggs until they are cooked to your desired consistency, typically 2 to 4 minutes. While the eggs are scrambling, gently warm the whole wheat tortillas. You can do this in a dry pan for about 15 seconds per side, or briefly in the microwave for 15-30 seconds, until they are pliable. Lay out each warm tortilla on a clean surface. Divide the scrambled egg and turkey mixture evenly between the two tortillas. Sprinkle the light cheddar cheese over the filling in each tortilla. Finally, slice the fresh avocado and distribute it over the mixture in each tortilla. Fold in the sides of each tortilla, then tightly roll them up from the bottom to form your breakfast burritos. Serve immediately for a delicious and healthy start to your day.

title: Hearty Southwestern Black Bean & Egg Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Whole wheat tortilla, large (70g each)", "4 pieces Egg, raw (60g each)", "100 g Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "50 g Bell pepper, red, fresh, diced", "50 g Onion, yellow, fresh, diced", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "30 g Avocado, fresh, sliced", "20 g Cheddar cheese, light, shredded", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Chili powder", "2 g Cumin powder", "20 g Salsa, mild, chunky", "1 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the diced red bell pepper and onion, and sauté for 5-7 minutes until they are softened and slightly translucent. Stir in the drained and rinsed black beans, chili powder, and cumin, cooking for another 2 minutes to allow the spices to become fragrant. Remove the vegetable and black bean mixture from the pan and set it aside in a bowl. In the same pan, whisk the raw eggs with salt and black pepper until well combined. Pour the egg mixture into the hot pan and scramble, stirring gently until the eggs are just cooked through but still moist. Gently fold in the fresh spinach until it wilts into the eggs. Warm the whole wheat tortillas individually in a dry pan or briefly in the microwave for 15-20 seconds until they are pliable. To assemble each burrito, place half of the scrambled egg and spinach mixture onto the center of a warm tortilla. Top with half of the sautéed vegetable and black bean mixture, half of the shredded light cheddar cheese, sliced avocado, and a dollop of salsa. Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then tightly roll it up from the bottom to create a compact burrito. Serve immediately for a satisfying breakfast.

title: Hearty Black Bean, Spinach, and Egg White Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Whole wheat tortilla, large (approx. 60g each)", "4 pieces Egg white, raw", "100 g Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Avocado, fresh", "30 g Salsa, mild", "10 ml Olive oil", "0.5 g Salt", "0.2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Remove the spinach from the skillet and set aside. In the same skillet, pour in the egg whites and scramble them gently until cooked through and fluffy, about 3-4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. While the eggs are cooking, warm the whole wheat tortillas in a separate dry pan or microwave for 15-20 seconds each, until pliable. To assemble, lay out each warm tortilla. Divide the scrambled egg whites, wilted spinach, black beans, diced avocado, and salsa evenly between the two tortillas. Carefully fold in the sides of each tortilla, then roll them up tightly from the bottom to form a burrito. Serve immediately.

title: Hearty Spinach and Mushroom Egg Bake
ingredients_json: ["12 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed (1.5% fat)", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "200 g Mushroom, white, raw", "150 g Onion, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "50 g Feta cheese, reduced fat, crumbled", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). Lightly grease a 23x33 cm (9x13 inch) baking dish. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and bell pepper and sauté for about 5-7 minutes until softened. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes until they release their liquid and start to brown. Finally, stir in the fresh spinach and cook until it wilts, about 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined. Stir the sautéed vegetables into the egg mixture. Pour the entire mixture into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese evenly over the top. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the casserole is set in the center and lightly golden on top. A knife inserted into the center should come out clean. Let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Healthy Veggie & Chicken Sausage Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_json: ["12 piece Egg, raw, large", "200 ml Milk, low fat, 1.5% fat", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "200 g Chicken sausage, pre-cooked, lean", "60 g Whole wheat bread, sliced", "50 g Cheese, hard, reduced fat", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch (or similar sized) baking dish with olive oil. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, low-fat milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined and frothy. Dice the bell pepper and onion into small pieces. Slice the pre-cooked chicken sausage into rounds or small cubes. In a large pan, heat the remaining olive oil over medium heat. Sauté the diced bell pepper and onion for about 5-7 minutes until they are softened. Add the fresh spinach to the pan and cook until it is wilted, which should take about 2-3 minutes. Remove the vegetable mixture from heat and let it cool slightly. Arrange the whole wheat bread slices in a single layer at the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Evenly spread the sautéed vegetable mixture and chicken sausage over the bread. Carefully pour the whisked egg mixture over everything, ensuring the bread is well soaked. Sprinkle the shredded reduced-fat cheese on top of the casserole. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the center is set and the top is lightly golden brown and puffed. Let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Spinach, Mushroom, and Feta Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_json: ["12 pieces Egg, raw", "2.5 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "300 g Spinach, raw", "200 g Mushrooms, common, raw", "150 g Onion, raw", "100 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "5 g Salt, table", "1 g Pepper, black, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Grease a 9x13 inch (approx. 23x33 cm) baking dish with a little olive oil. Finely chop the onion and slice the mushrooms. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and begin to brown, about 7-10 minutes. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook just until it wilts, which should only take a couple of minutes. Remove the skillet from the heat. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until well combined. Crumble the reduced-fat feta cheese into the egg mixture. Stir in the sautéed vegetable mixture from the skillet. Pour the entire mixture into the prepared baking dish. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the casserole is set in the center and lightly golden on top. Let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Wholesome Spinach and Sweet Potato Feta Casserole
ingredients_json: ["12 pieces Egg, raw, unspecified", "2.5 dl Milk, skimmed", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "300 g Sweet potato, raw", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "80 g Feta cheese, light", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch (approx. 23x33 cm) baking dish with a small amount of olive oil. Dice the sweet potato into small, uniform cubes and finely chop the onion. In a large non-stick skillet, heat the remaining olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced sweet potato and chopped onion to the skillet and sauté for about 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook for another 2-3 minutes until it has completely wilted. Remove the skillet from the heat and spread the cooked vegetable mixture evenly across the bottom of the prepared baking dish. In a separate large bowl, whisk together the eggs, skimmed milk, salt, and black pepper until the mixture is well combined and slightly frothy. Crumble the light feta cheese evenly over the vegetables in the baking dish. Carefully pour the whisked egg mixture over the vegetables and feta, ensuring everything is submerged. Bake the casserole for 30-35 minutes, or until the center is set and the top has turned a beautiful golden brown. Allow the casserole to rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Hearty Spinach, Feta, and Sweet Potato Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_json: ["8 pieces Egg, raw, chicken", "2.5 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "300 g Sweet potato, raw", "200 g Spinach, raw", "70 g Feta cheese, full fat", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "10 g Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "0.5 g Nutmeg, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). Peel the sweet potato and cut it into small cubes, about 1 cm in size. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet or a regular pan over medium heat. Add the sweet potato cubes and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, continuing to cook for another 3-5 minutes until the onion is translucent. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook just until it wilts, which will only take a couple of minutes. Season with salt, black pepper, and nutmeg. In a separate large bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk until well combined. Crumble the feta cheese into the egg mixture. If using an oven-safe skillet, pour the egg mixture over the vegetables. If not, transfer the vegetable mixture to a 20x20 cm (8x8 inch) baking dish before pouring the eggs over. Gently stir to ensure the vegetables are evenly distributed. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the center is set and the top is lightly golden brown. Let the casserole rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Herbed Sweet Potato and Spinach Hash with Poached Eggs
ingredients_json: ["300 g Sweet potato, raw, peeled, diced", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "100 g Onion, yellow, diced", "1 clove Garlic, fresh, minced", "2 piece Egg, raw", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 g Rosemary, dried", "2 g Thyme, dried", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt, table", "15 ml White vinegar, distilled"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the diced sweet potato and onion, season with 1.5 grams of salt, 0.5 grams of pepper, 1 gram of rosemary, and 1 gram of thyme. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and lightly browned. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. While the hash is cooking, bring a small saucepan of water to a gentle simmer with the white vinegar. Carefully crack each egg into a separate small bowl, then gently slide them into the simmering water. Poach for 3-4 minutes for a runny yolk, or longer for a firmer yolk. Remove the eggs with a slotted spoon and drain any excess water. Divide the sweet potato and spinach hash evenly between two plates and top each serving with a freshly poached egg. Sprinkle with the remaining salt and pepper if desired.

title: Mediterranean Herb Roasted Breakfast Potatoes with Spinach and Feta
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potato, red skin, raw", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "100 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Spinach, raw", "2 g Garlic powder", "2 g Paprika powder", "1 g Dried oregano", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table", "40 g Feta cheese, full-fat, crumbled"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). Wash and dice the red skin potatoes into 2 cm cubes, leaving the skin on for added nutrients. In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes with olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, dried oregano, black pepper, and half of the salt. Toss until the potatoes are evenly coated. Spread the seasoned potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet. Roast for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until they are tender and golden brown. While the potatoes are roasting, dice the onion and red bell pepper. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the pan and sauté for 5-7 minutes until softened. Once the potatoes are ready, add them to the pan with the sautéed vegetables. Stir in the fresh spinach and the remaining salt. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, or until the spinach has wilted. Transfer the breakfast potatoes to serving plates and sprinkle generously with crumbled feta cheese before serving warm.

title: Mediterranean Roasted Sweet Potato Hash with Spinach and Feta
ingredients_json: ["400 g Sweet potato, raw, with skin", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 g Paprika powder, ground", "1 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "100 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Feta cheese, full fat", "2 pieces Egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Wash the sweet potatoes thoroughly, then dice them into 1-1.5 cm cubes. Dice the onion and bell pepper into similar-sized pieces. In a large bowl, combine the diced sweet potatoes, onion, and bell pepper with the olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper, ensuring everything is well coated. Spread the seasoned vegetables in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and lightly caramelized, flipping halfway through. While the vegetables are roasting, crumble the feta cheese. Once the roasted vegetables are out of the oven, stir in the fresh spinach, allowing the residual heat to wilt it. Gently fold in the crumbled feta cheese. Fry or poach the two eggs to your liking. Divide the warm sweet potato hash between two plates and top each serving with a freshly cooked egg.

title: Mediterranean Herb Roasted Breakfast Potatoes with Bell Peppers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["400 g Potato, white, raw", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "100 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "50 g Spinach, raw", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 g Garlic powder", "2 g Dried oregano", "2 g Dried thyme", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). Wash the potatoes thoroughly, then chop them into 1.5 cm cubes, leaving the skin on for extra nutrients. Dice the onion and bell pepper into similar-sized pieces. In a large mixing bowl, combine the chopped potatoes, onion, and bell pepper. Drizzle with olive oil, then sprinkle with garlic powder, dried oregano, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, tossing well to ensure all vegetables are evenly coated. Spread the seasoned vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet. Roast for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the potatoes are tender and golden brown. In the last 5 minutes of roasting, add the fresh spinach to the baking sheet, tossing it with the roasted vegetables, and continue cooking until the spinach is just wilted. Serve immediately.

title: Wholesome Whole Wheat Apple Cinnamon Rolls with Light Glaze
ingredients_json: ["250 ml Milk, low-fat, 1.5% fat", "7 g Yeast, dry active", "30 g Honey, liquid", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "40 g Butter, unsalted, light spread", "350 g Flour, wheat, whole grain", "150 g Flour, wheat, refined, all-purpose", "5 g Salt, table", "2 pieces Apple, medium, fresh", "40 g Brown sugar, light", "10 g Cinnamon, ground", "20 g Butter, unsalted, light spread", "50 g Sweetener, powdered, erythritol blend", "30 ml Milk, low-fat, 1.5% fat", "2 ml Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Warm the 250 ml of low-fat milk to about 40°C. In a large bowl, dissolve the dry active yeast and honey in the warm milk, letting it sit for 5-10 minutes until foamy. Whisk in the egg and 40 g of melted light butter. In a separate bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until a shaggy dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 8-10 minutes until it is smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with a clean kitchen towel, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-1.5 hours, or until doubled in size. While the dough is rising, prepare the filling: peel, core, and finely dice the two medium apples. In a small bowl, combine the diced apples, brown sugar, and ground cinnamon. Once the dough has doubled, gently punch it down and roll it out into a large rectangle, approximately 30x45 cm, on a lightly floured surface. Spread the 20 g of softened light butter evenly over the dough, then sprinkle the apple-cinnamon mixture over the butter, leaving a small border at one edge. Tightly roll the dough up from the long side, creating a log. Using a sharp knife or dental floss, slice the log into 12 equal rolls. Arrange the rolls in a lightly greased 23x33 cm baking dish, leaving a little space between each. Cover the dish and let the rolls rise again for 30-45 minutes, or until puffy. Preheat your oven to 190°C. Bake the cinnamon rolls for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the rolls are baking, prepare the light glaze: whisk together the powdered erythritol blend sweetener, 30 ml of low-fat milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Once the rolls are out of the oven, let them cool slightly in the dish for about 10 minutes before drizzling generously with the light glaze. Serve warm.

title: Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["400 g Wheat flour, whole grain", "100 g Wheat flour, white, enriched", "2.5 dl Milk, low fat (1.5% fat), lukewarm", "7 g Yeast, active dry", "1 piece Egg, raw, large, room temperature", "30 g Sugar, brown, light", "40 g Butter, unsalted, melted", "3 g Salt, table", "20 g Butter, unsalted, melted", "2 tbsp Cinnamon, ground", "40 g Sugar, brown, light", "150 g Yogurt, Greek, plain, 0% fat", "2 tbsp Maple syrup, pure", "0.5 tsp Vanilla extract"]

Mix with a spoon until a shaggy dough forms, then turn it out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead the dough for 8-10 minutes until it is smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a clean kitchen towel or plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 to 1.5 hours, or until doubled in size. Once the dough has doubled, gently punch it down and roll it out into a large rectangle, approximately 30x40 cm, on a lightly floured surface. Brush the dough evenly with 20g melted butter, then sprinkle the cinnamon-sugar mixture over the entire surface. Starting from one long edge, tightly roll up the dough into a log. Using a sharp knife or unflavored dental floss, cut the log into 9 equal pieces. Arrange the cinnamon rolls in a lightly greased 23x23 cm (9x9 inch) baking dish, leaving a small space between each. Cover the dish and let the rolls rise again in a warm place for another 30-45 minutes, or until puffy. Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). Bake the cinnamon rolls for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the rolls are baking, prepare the glaze by whisking together the Greek yogurt, maple syrup, and vanilla extract until smooth. Once the rolls are out of the oven, let them cool slightly for about 10 minutes before drizzling generously with the Greek yogurt glaze. Serve warm.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["300 g Flour, whole wheat", "10 g Yeast, active dry", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g Maple syrup", "30 g Butter, unsalted, melted", "3 g Salt, table", "10 g Cinnamon, ground", "20 g Brown sugar", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "15 g Maple syrup", "2 ml Vanilla extract"]

Arrange the rolls in a lightly greased 23x23 cm baking dish, leaving a little space between them. While the rolls are cooling slightly, prepare the glaze by whisking together the Greek yogurt, 15 grams of maple syrup, and vanilla extract in a small bowl. title: Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["2.5 dl Milk, skimmed, 0.5% fat", "7 g Yeast, dry", "30 g Honey", "40 g Butter, unsalted", "450 g Flour, whole grain, wheat", "5 g Salt, table", "1 piece Egg, raw, chicken", "40 g Sugar, brown, light", "7 g Cinnamon, ground", "20 g Butter, unsalted, softened", "100 g Yogurt, Greek style, plain, 0% fat", "20 g Honey", "5 ml Vanilla extract"]

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Glaze

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Blueberry Greek Yogurt Coffee Cake
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour, fine", "50 g Rolled oats, dry", "70 g Brown sugar, packed", "10 g Baking powder", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 g Salt, table", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "60 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "60 ml Milk, low fat, 1.5% fat", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "200 g Blueberries, fresh", "30 g Rolled oats, dry", "10 g Brown sugar, packed", "10 g Whole wheat flour, fine", "10 g Butter, unsalted", "2 g Cinnamon, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius and grease and flour an 8x8 inch (20x20 cm) baking pan. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the 200 g whole wheat flour, 50 g rolled oats, 70 g brown sugar, baking powder, 2 g cinnamon for the cake, and salt until well combined. In a separate medium bowl, whisk the egg, Greek yogurt, olive oil, low-fat milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix gently until just combined, being careful not to overmix, which can lead to a tough cake. Gently fold in the fresh blueberries. For the streusel topping, combine the 30 g rolled oats, 10 g brown sugar, 10 g whole wheat flour, melted unsalted butter, and 2 g cinnamon in a small bowl, mixing with a fork until the mixture forms a crumbly texture. Pour the cake batter evenly into the prepared baking pan, then sprinkle the streusel mixture over the top. title: Wholesome Berry & Greek Yogurt Danishes
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g All-purpose flour", "7 g Dry yeast", "100 ml Skimmed milk", "50 g Unsalted butter, softened", "1 piece Egg, large, raw", "15 g Granulated sugar", "3 g Salt", "100 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "200 g Mixed berries, fresh (e.g., raspberries, blueberries)", "15 g Granulated sugar", "10 ml Lemon juice", "5 g Corn starch", "100 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "50 g Cream cheese, light", "10 ml Vanilla extract", "1 piece Egg, large, raw (for egg wash)", "10 ml Water (for egg wash)"]
instructions: In a small bowl, warm the skimmed milk slightly (to about 40°C) and stir in the dry yeast and 5g of the first portion of granulated sugar. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes until foamy. Add the softened unsalted butter, one large egg, 100g of Greek yogurt, and the activated yeast mixture to the flour mixture. Knead the dough for 8-10 minutes until it is smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with a clean cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-1.5 hours, or until doubled in size. While the dough is rising, prepare the berry compote by combining the mixed berries, 15g granulated sugar, and lemon juice in a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then dissolve the corn starch in a tablespoon of cold water and stir into the berries. Cook, stirring constantly, until the compote thickens. Remove from heat and let it cool completely. In a separate bowl, prepare the cream cheese filling by whisking together 100g Greek yogurt, light cream cheese, and vanilla extract until smooth. Once the dough has risen, punch it down gently and roll it out on a lightly floured surface into a large rectangle, approximately 0.5 cm thick. Cut the dough into 8-10 squares or rectangles. Place a spoonful of the cream cheese filling in the center of each dough piece, followed by a spoonful of the cooled berry compote. Fold the corners of each square towards the center, pinching them together to form a Danish shape, leaving the filling partially exposed. Arrange the shaped Danishes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving some space between them. Cover loosely and let them rise again for another 30 minutes. Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). In a small bowl, whisk the second large egg with 10ml of water for an egg wash. Gently brush the tops of the Danishes with the egg wash. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the Danishes are golden brown and puffed. Let them cool slightly on a wire rack before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Berry and Lemon Cream Cheese Danishes

title: Whole Wheat Berry & Lemon Quark Danishes

title: Mediterranean Spinach and Feta Frittata
ingredients_json: ["6 pieces Egg, raw, large", "50 ml Milk, whole, unspecified", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "50 g Onion, yellow, raw, finely chopped", "1 clove Garlic, raw, minced", "100 g Fresh spinach, washed and roughly chopped", "100 g Cherry tomatoes, raw, halved", "50 g Feta cheese, full fat, crumbled", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe, non-stick skillet (about 20-22 cm diameter) over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened and translucent. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the fresh spinach to the skillet and cook until it has completely wilted, about 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Evenly spread the spinach and onion mixture across the bottom of the skillet. Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet. Scatter the halved cherry tomatoes and crumbled feta cheese evenly over the top of the egg mixture. Let the frittata cook on the stovetop for about 3-5 minutes, or until the edges begin to set. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the frittata is puffed up, golden brown, and set in the center. Carefully remove the frittata from the oven and let it cool in the skillet for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Maple Pecan Super Seed Granola

Add the spinach and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes, then remove it from the pan and set aside. Add the cherry tomatoes to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened. Pour the egg mixture into the hot pan, tilting to evenly coat the bottom. As the edges set, gently push the cooked egg toward the center, allowing uncooked egg to flow underneath. When the omelet is mostly set but still slightly moist on top, sprinkle the wilted spinach and crumbled feta cheese over one half. Fold the other half of the omelet over the filling and cook for another minute until the cheese is slightly warmed through. Slide the omelet onto a plate and serve immediately.

title: Healthy Spinach and Feta Omelet
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Egg, raw", "1 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "100 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "30 g Onion, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "0.5 g Salt, table", "0.2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: First, finely chop the onion. Wash the spinach thoroughly. In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and pepper until well combined and slightly frothy. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 2-3 minutes until softened. Stir in the spinach and cook until it wilts completely, which should take about 2 minutes. Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the pan, ensuring it spreads evenly. Immediately sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese over the top. Cook undisturbed for 3-4 minutes, or until the edges begin to set and the bottom is golden brown. Gently fold the omelet in half and cook for another minute until the cheese is slightly melted and the omelet is cooked to your desired consistency. Slide onto a plate and serve immediately.

title: Vibrant Spinach and Bell Pepper Omelet
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Egg, raw", "30 ml Milk, low fat, 1.5% fat", "100 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "20 g Onion, raw", "5 g Olive oil", "1 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs and low-fat milk together in a bowl until thoroughly combined, then season with salt and black pepper. Finely chop the onion and red bell pepper. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and bell pepper and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook until it wilts, about 1-2 minutes. Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the pan. Let it cook undisturbed for 2-3 minutes until the edges begin to set. Gently lift one side of the omelet with a spatula and tilt the pan to allow any uncooked egg to flow underneath. Continue cooking for another 1-2 minutes until the omelet is mostly set but still slightly moist on top. Carefully fold the omelet in half and slide it onto a plate.

title: Mediterranean Spinach and Feta Omelet
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Egg, raw", "15 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "5 ml Olive oil", "50 g Spinach, raw", "60 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "20 g Feta cheese, light", "0.5 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper in a small bowl until well combined and slightly frothy. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes until wilted. Add the cherry tomatoes, halved, and cook for another 1-2 minutes until slightly softened. Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the pan. As the edges begin to set, gently push the cooked egg towards the center, tilting the pan to allow the uncooked egg to flow underneath. Once the omelet is mostly set but still slightly moist on top, sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese over one half. Carefully fold the omelet in half and cook for another 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until the cheese is slightly warmed and the omelet is cooked to your desired doneness. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Pancakes with Berries and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 medium Banana, ripe", "5 g Baking powder", "5 ml Olive oil", "150 g Mixed berries, fresh", "150 g Greek yogurt, natural, 0% fat", "15 ml Maple syrup"]
instructions: First, mash the ripe banana in a large bowl until smooth. Add the whole wheat flour, semi-skimmed milk, raw egg, and baking powder to the bowl. Whisk all the ingredients together until just combined, being careful not to overmix, as a few lumps are fine. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with 5 ml of olive oil. Pour about 60 ml (1/4 cup) of batter per pancake onto the hot pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter. Once all pancakes are cooked, stack them on plates. Top each serving with 75 g of fresh mixed berries and 75 g of natural 0% fat Greek yogurt. Drizzle with 7.5 ml of maple syrup per serving before serving warm.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Blueberry Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["150 g Wheat flour, whole grain", "200 ml Milk, skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw", "10 g Baking powder", "20 g Maple syrup", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "10 ml Olive oil", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "20 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the whole grain wheat flour and baking powder. In a separate medium bowl, whisk the skimmed milk, raw egg, and 10 g of the maple syrup until well combined. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined; do not overmix, as a few lumps are fine. Gently fold in the fresh blueberries. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat and lightly coat with a small amount of olive oil. Pour about 60 ml of batter per pancake onto the hot pan, cooking for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter, adding more olive oil as needed. Serve the warm pancakes topped with the plain Greek yogurt, the remaining 10 g of maple syrup, and chopped walnuts.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Oat Pancakes with Mixed Berries
ingredients_json: ["100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats, uncooked", "10 g Baking powder", "1 piece Banana, medium, ripe", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "5 g Coconut oil, virgin, for cooking", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "50 g Strawberries, fresh"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, and baking powder until well combined. In a separate medium bowl, mash the ripe banana thoroughly with a fork. Add the semi-skimmed milk, raw egg, and vanilla extract to the mashed banana, then whisk everything together until smooth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix gently until just combined; it's okay if there are a few lumps. Do not overmix. Heat a non-stick frying pan or griddle over medium heat and add the coconut oil, swirling to coat the surface. Pour about 60 ml of batter per pancake onto the hot pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and bubbles form on the surface before flipping. Once cooked, remove pancakes from the pan and keep warm while you cook the remaining batter. Serve the warm pancakes immediately, topped with fresh blueberries and sliced strawberries.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Banana Berry Pancakes
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "1 piece Banana, ripe, medium", "5 g Baking powder", "1 g Salt, table", "10 g Maple syrup, pure", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "5 g Olive oil, extra virgin"]
instructions: Begin by mashing the ripe banana in a large bowl until mostly smooth. In the same bowl, whisk in the egg, semi-skimmed milk, and maple syrup until well combined. Be careful not to overmix; a few lumps are fine. Gently fold in the fresh blueberries. Heat a large non-stick frying pan or griddle over medium heat and lightly coat with a small amount of olive oil. Pour about 60 ml of batter per pancake onto the hot pan, ensuring not to overcrowd it. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and bubbles appear on the surface before flipping. Serve the pancakes warm, optionally with a drizzle of extra maple syrup or a handful of fresh berries.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Banana Oat Pancakes with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Ground cinnamon", "1 g Salt", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "150 g Banana, ripe", "3 ml Vanilla extract", "5 ml Olive oil", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "15 ml Maple syrup"]

Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined; it's okay if there are a few lumps, but do not overmix. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat and lightly grease it with a small amount of olive oil. Pour about 60 ml of batter per pancake onto the hot pan, cooking for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. title: Healthy Whole Wheat Popovers with Herbed Scrambled Eggs and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["150 ml Milk, low fat, 1.5% fat", "2 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "120 g Flour, wheat, whole grain", "2 g Salt, table", "5 ml Olive oil, extra virgin (for popovers)", "3 pieces Egg, white, raw", "100 g Spinach, raw", "10 g Chives, fresh", "5 ml Olive oil, extra virgin (for scrambled eggs)"]
instructions: To begin, preheat your oven to 220 degrees Celsius. Place an empty popover pan or a 6-cup muffin tin into the preheating oven for at least 10 minutes to ensure it is very hot. While the pan heats, whisk together the low-fat milk, two whole eggs, and salt in a large bowl until well combined and frothy. Gradually add the whole wheat flour to the wet ingredients, whisking continuously until the batter is smooth and free of lumps. Be careful not to overmix. Carefully remove the hot popover pan from the oven and quickly brush the bottom and sides of each cup with 5 ml of olive oil. Pour the batter evenly into the hot, oiled cups, filling each approximately two-thirds full. Immediately return the pan to the oven and bake for 20 minutes at 220 degrees Celsius. Without opening the oven door, reduce the temperature to 175 degrees Celsius and continue baking for another 15-20 minutes, or until the popovers are deeply golden brown and puffed. While the popovers are baking, prepare the scrambled eggs. In a separate bowl, whisk together the three egg whites. Heat the remaining 5 ml of olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the raw spinach and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Pour in the whisked egg whites and gently scramble until cooked through but still moist. Finely chop the fresh chives and stir them into the scrambled eggs just before serving. Once the popovers are done, remove them from the oven and carefully remove them from the pan. Serve the warm popovers immediately with the herbed spinach scrambled eggs on the side for a complete and healthy breakfast.

title: Savory Whole Wheat Herb Popovers
ingredients_json: ["120 g Flour, whole grain, wheat", "2 piece Egg, raw, whole, large", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed (1.5% fat)", "5 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "1.5 g Salt, table", "3 g Chives, fresh, chopped", "3 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). Place a 6-cup popover or Yorkshire pudding tin into the oven and let it heat up for at least 10 minutes. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour and salt thoroughly. In a separate bowl, lightly whisk the eggs, then gradually incorporate the semi-skimmed milk until the mixture is well combined. Slowly pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, whisking continuously until a smooth batter forms. Gently stir in the chopped fresh chives and parsley, being careful not to overmix, as this can result in tough popovers. Carefully remove the hot popover tin from the oven. Add approximately 5 ml of olive oil to the bottom of each cup (roughly 0.8 ml per cup); the oil should sizzle immediately. Quickly and evenly divide the batter among the six hot cups, filling each approximately two-thirds full. Immediately return the tin to the hot oven. Bake for 20 minutes at 220°C, then reduce the oven temperature to 175°C (350°F) and continue baking for another 10-15 minutes, or until the popovers are deeply golden brown, well-puffed, and firm. It's crucial not to open the oven door during the first 25 minutes of baking, as this can cause the popovers to collapse. Once baked, remove them from the oven and serve immediately for the best texture and flavor.

title: Savory Whole Wheat Popovers with Spinach and Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["120 g Whole wheat flour", "2 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "240 ml Milk, low fat, 1.5% fat", "5 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "5 ml Olive oil, extra virgin (for greasing tins)", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "80 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "15 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). Place a 6-cup popover or standard muffin tin into the oven to preheat for at least 10-15 minutes, ensuring it is very hot. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, salt, and black pepper until well combined. In a separate medium bowl, lightly whisk the eggs, then gradually incorporate the milk and 5 ml of olive oil until thoroughly mixed. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk gently until just combined; it is important not to overmix, a few small lumps are perfectly acceptable. Carefully remove the hot popover tin from the oven. Quickly add approximately 0.5 ml of olive oil to the bottom of each cup and swirl it to coat evenly. Immediately fill each hot cup about halfway with the prepared batter. Distribute the fresh spinach leaves and halved cherry tomatoes evenly among the batter-filled cups, pressing them gently into the batter. Sprinkle a small amount of grated Parmesan cheese over the top of each popover. Promptly return the tin to the hot oven and bake for 20 minutes without opening the oven door, as this can cause the popovers to collapse. After 20 minutes, reduce the oven temperature to 175°C (350°F) and continue baking for another 10-15 minutes, or until the popovers are puffed, golden brown, and feel firm to the touch. Serve these wholesome and savory popovers immediately for a delicious breakfast.

title: Whole Wheat Savory Popovers with Spinach and Feta
ingredients_json: ["100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Wheat flour, all-purpose, enriched", "2 pieces Egg, raw, large", "3 dl Milk, low-fat, 1.5% fat", "100 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 230 degrees Celsius. Place a popover pan or a 6-cup muffin tin with deep wells in the oven while it preheats to get it very hot. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk until well combined. Gradually add the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, salt, and black pepper to the wet ingredients, whisking until just combined. Be careful not to overmix; a few small lumps are perfectly fine. Gently fold in the raw spinach and crumbled reduced-fat feta cheese. Carefully remove the hot popover pan from the oven and brush each well generously with olive oil. Pour the batter evenly into the hot, oiled wells, filling each about two-thirds full. Immediately return the pan to the oven and bake at 230 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes without opening the oven door. Reduce the oven temperature to 175 degrees Celsius and continue baking for another 10-15 minutes, or until the popovers are golden brown, puffed high, and firm to the touch. Remove the popovers from the pan and serve immediately.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Herb Popovers with Whipped Feta and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["120 g Flour, whole wheat", "2 pieces Egg, raw, large", "250 ml Milk, cow's, low fat, 1% fat", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "5 g Chives, fresh, chopped", "5 g Parsley, fresh, chopped", "50 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "10 ml Lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Place a 6-cup popover or muffin tin (if you don't have popover molds) into the oven to heat for at least 10-15 minutes. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and olive oil until well combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, salt, chopped fresh chives, and parsley. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, whisking until the batter is smooth and lump-free. Gently fold in the raw spinach. Carefully remove the hot popover tin from the oven. Pour the batter evenly into the hot molds, filling each about two-thirds full. Immediately return the tin to the oven and bake for 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, reduce the oven temperature to 180°C and bake for another 15-20 minutes, or until the popovers are golden brown, puffed high, and firm. Do not open the oven door during the first 20 minutes of baking. While the popovers are baking, prepare the whipped feta. In a small bowl, combine the reduced-fat feta cheese and lemon juice. Using a fork or a small whisk, mash and whip until the feta is creamy and light. Once baked, remove the popovers from the oven and serve immediately with the whipped feta.

title: Hearty Whole Wheat Potato Pancakes
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potato, raw, unspecified", "100 g Onion, raw, unspecified", "2 piece Egg, raw, unspecified", "30 g Whole wheat flour, unspecified", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin"]
instructions: Begin by peeling the potatoes and onion. Using a box grater or food processor, grate both the potatoes and onion finely. Place the grated mixture into a clean kitchen towel or cheesecloth and squeeze out as much excess moisture as possible; this is crucial for crispy pancakes. In a large bowl, combine the drained potato and onion mixture with the raw eggs, whole wheat flour, salt, and black pepper. Mix thoroughly until all ingredients are well incorporated. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Once hot, spoon about 2-3 tablespoons of the potato mixture per pancake into the pan, flattening gently with the back of the spoon to form thin discs. Cook for 4-6 minutes on each side, or until golden brown, crispy, and cooked through in the center. You may need to cook in batches, adding a tiny bit more oil if necessary for subsequent batches. Serve the potato pancakes immediately, perhaps with a side of plain Greek yogurt or applesauce for a complete breakfast.

title: Healthy Sweet Potato & Zucchini Pancakes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["400 g Sweet potato, raw", "150 g Zucchini, raw", "50 g Onion, yellow, raw", "2 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "3 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "20 ml Olive oil", "150 g Yogurt, Greek, plain, 0% fat", "10 g Chives, fresh"]
instructions: Begin by grating the sweet potato and zucchini using a coarse grater. Place the grated vegetables in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much excess liquid as possible. Finely chop the onion. In a large bowl, combine the squeezed sweet potato and zucchini, chopped onion, eggs, whole wheat flour, salt, and black pepper. Mix everything thoroughly until well combined. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture into the hot skillet, flattening them slightly with the back of a spoon to form pancakes about 8-10 cm in diameter. Cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. You may need to cook them in batches, adding a little more oil if necessary. Once all pancakes are cooked, serve immediately with a dollop of Greek yogurt and a sprinkle of freshly chopped chives.

title: Savory Sweet Potato & Potato Pancakes with Fresh Parsley
ingredients_json: ["400 g Potato, raw, white flesh", "200 g Sweet potato, raw, orange flesh", "100 g Onion, raw", "2 piece Egg, raw, large", "60 g Whole wheat flour", "10 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "5 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "1.5 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Peel and grate both the white potatoes and sweet potatoes. Grate the onion as well. Place all grated vegetables in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much excess moisture as possible. In a large bowl, combine the squeezed grated vegetables with the eggs, whole wheat flour, chopped fresh parsley, salt, and black pepper. Mix thoroughly until all ingredients are well combined. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Drop spoonfuls of the potato mixture into the hot pan, using the back of the spoon or a spatula to flatten them into pancakes approximately 1 cm thick. Cook for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through in the center. Adjust heat as needed to prevent burning. Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Savory Potato Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Chives
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potato, raw, unspecified", "50 g Onion, raw", "1 piece Egg, raw", "20 g Whole wheat flour", "3 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "15 ml Olive oil", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "5 g Chives, fresh"]

Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Cook for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy. Repeat with the remaining mixture, adding more oil if necessary. title: Hearty Sweet Potato and Zucchini Pancakes
ingredients_json: ["300 g Sweet potato, raw, peeled", "150 g Zucchini, raw", "50 g Onion, yellow, raw", "2 piece Egg, raw", "30 g Whole wheat flour", "5 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Grate the peeled sweet potato and zucchini using a box grater. Squeeze out excess liquid from the grated vegetables thoroughly using a clean kitchen towel to ensure crispier pancakes. Finely chop the onion. In a large bowl, combine the grated sweet potato, zucchini, chopped onion, both eggs, whole wheat flour, salt, and black pepper. Mix everything well with a spoon or your hands until all ingredients are evenly incorporated. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture into the hot pan, forming pancakes approximately 1 cm thick and about 7-8 cm in diameter. Cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until each pancake is golden brown and cooked through in the center. Serve immediately with your favorite healthy toppings like Greek yogurt or a side of avocado.

title: Healthy Spiced Whole Wheat Pumpkin Bread with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "10 g Baking powder", "5 g Baking soda", "3 g Salt, table", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Nutmeg, ground", "1 g Ginger, ground", "1 g Cloves, ground", "400 g Pumpkin puree, canned, unsweetened", "2 piece Egg, raw, large", "80 ml Maple syrup", "80 ml Canola oil", "80 ml Applesauce, unsweetened", "60 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees Celsius and lightly grease and flour a standard loaf pan. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and cloves until well combined. In a separate medium bowl, whisk the pumpkin puree, eggs, maple syrup, canola oil, and unsweetened applesauce until smooth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently with a spatula until just combined; be careful not to overmix. Fold in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Spiced Whole Wheat Pumpkin Bread with Pecans
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "10 g Baking powder", "5 g Baking soda", "5 g Ground cinnamon", "2 g Ground nutmeg", "2 g Ground ginger", "0.5 g Ground cloves", "2 g Salt", "400 g Pumpkin puree, canned, unsweetened", "2 piece Egg, raw, unspecified", "100 ml Maple syrup, pure", "60 ml Olive oil, virgin", "80 ml Almond milk, unsweetened", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "50 g Pecans, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius and lightly grease and flour a standard loaf pan. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, ground ginger, ground cloves, and salt until well combined. In a separate medium bowl, whisk the pumpkin puree, eggs, maple syrup, olive oil, almond milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently with a spatula until just combined; be careful not to overmix. Fold in the raw pecans evenly throughout the batter. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and spread evenly. Bake for 55 to 65 minutes, or until a wooden skewer or toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the bread cool in the pan for 10-15 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing and serving.

title: Spiced Whole Wheat Pumpkin Bread with Pecans
ingredients_json: ["300 g Pumpkin puree", "250 g Whole wheat flour", "2 pieces Egg, raw, large", "80 ml Maple syrup", "60 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "50 ml Milk, low-fat, semi-skimmed", "10 g Baking powder", "5 g Baking soda", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Nutmeg, ground", "1 g Ginger, ground", "0.5 g Cloves, ground", "2 g Salt, table", "50 g Pecans, halves"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F) and lightly grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan. In a large bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, eggs, maple syrup, olive oil, and milk until well combined. In a separate medium bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, ground cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, cloves, and salt, mixing thoroughly. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing just until combined and no streaks of flour remain, being careful not to overmix. Gently fold in the pecan halves. Allow the bread to cool in the pan for 10-15 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing and serving.

title: Spiced Whole Wheat Pumpkin Loaf with Toasted Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour, white", "450 g Pumpkin puree, canned, unsweetened", "2 pieces Egg, raw, chicken", "100 ml Maple syrup, pure", "60 ml Rapeseed oil", "100 ml Milk, cow's, semi-skimmed (1.5% fat)", "10 g Baking powder", "5 g Baking soda", "5 g Ground cinnamon", "2 g Ground nutmeg", "1 g Ground ginger", "0.5 g Ground cloves", "2 g Salt, table", "70 g Walnuts, raw, chopped"]

If the top begins to brown too quickly, you may loosely tent it with aluminum foil during the last part of baking. Once baked, let the loaf cool in the pan for 10 minutes before carefully transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing and serving.

title: Wholesome Spiced Pumpkin Bread with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "10 g Baking powder, double-acting", "5 g Baking soda", "3 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 g Ginger, ground", "1 g Nutmeg, ground", "0.5 g Cloves, ground", "1 g Salt, table", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "70 ml Maple syrup, pure", "60 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "250 g Pumpkin puree, canned, unsweetened", "60 ml Milk, cow's, 1% fat", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "50 g Walnuts, chopped"]

title: Herb-Crusted Beef Tenderloin with Roasted Asparagus and Sweet Potato Mash
ingredients_json: ["600 g Beef tenderloin, trimmed", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "4 pieces Garlic cloves, peeled", "2 sprigs Fresh rosemary", "2 sprigs Fresh thyme", "8 g Salt, table", "3 g Black pepper, ground", "500 g Asparagus, fresh", "800 g Sweet potato, raw, peeled", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "20 g Butter, unsalted"]
instructions:
Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius. Pat the beef tenderloin dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, finely chop the leaves from one sprig of rosemary and one sprig of thyme. Crush two garlic cloves. Rub the beef tenderloin with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, then generously season it with half of the salt, half of the black pepper, and the chopped herbs and crushed garlic. Heat an oven-safe skillet over high heat with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Sear the beef tenderloin on all sides until well browned, about 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 15-20 minutes for medium-rare, or until it reaches your desired doneness. Remove from the oven, transfer to a cutting board, and let it rest for at least 10 minutes, tented loosely with foil.

While the beef roasts, prepare the vegetables. Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus spears. Toss the asparagus with a drizzle of olive oil, a pinch of salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast in the same oven for the last 10-12 minutes of the beef's cooking time, or until tender-crisp. For the sweet potato mash, peel and chop the sweet potatoes into 2-3 cm cubes. Place them in a pot of cold salted water and bring to a boil. Cook until fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain well. Return the sweet potatoes to the pot. Add the milk, butter, the remaining crushed garlic cloves (minced), the remaining salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

Sear the beef pieces on all sides until browned, then remove them from the pot and set aside. Reduce the heat to medium, then add the diced onion to the pot and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
