Add the grated carrots and beets to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 8-10 minutes, allowing them to soften slightly. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then deglaze the pot with apple cider vinegar, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Return the seared beef to the pot, then pour in the beef broth. Add the cubed potatoes, thinly sliced cabbage, salt, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for at least 45 minutes, or until the beef is tender and the vegetables are fully cooked. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Just before serving, stir in the fresh chopped dill. Serve the borscht hot, with a dollop of light sour cream on top of each bowl.

title: Hearty Vegetarian Beet and Cabbage Borscht
ingredients_json: ["400 g Beets, raw, peeled, diced", "300 g Cabbage, white, shredded", "200 g Potatoes, raw, peeled, diced", "150 g Carrots, raw, peeled, diced", "150 g Onion, yellow, diced", "20 g Garlic, cloves, minced", "400 g Tomatoes, canned, crushed", "1.5 L Vegetable broth, low sodium", "30 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "30 ml Apple cider vinegar", "15 g Dill, fresh, chopped", "5 g Bay leaves, dried", "3 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt, fine", "150 g Sour cream, light, 10% fat"]
instructions: Begin by heating the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion and sauté until softened and translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in the diced carrots and cook for another 5-7 minutes, allowing them to soften slightly. Next, add the minced garlic and cook for just 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Introduce the diced beets to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Now, add the shredded cabbage, diced potatoes, crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and let it simmer for 30-40 minutes, or until all the vegetables are tender. Once the vegetables are cooked through, remove the bay leaves. Stir in the apple cider vinegar and fresh chopped dill. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Ladle the hot borscht into bowls and serve with a dollop of light sour cream on top.

title: Hearty Vegetarian Borscht with Dill and Light Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 g Beetroot, raw, peeled and shredded", "300 g Cabbage, white, shredded", "200 g Potato, raw, peeled and diced", "150 g Carrot, raw, peeled and shredded", "150 g Onion, raw, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "50 g Tomato paste", "1.5 l Vegetable broth, low sodium", "100 ml Water", "1 tbsp Apple cider vinegar", "1 pc Bay leaf", "0.5 tsp Black peppercorns, whole", "10 g Salt", "5 g Black pepper, ground", "50 g Dill, fresh, chopped", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat"]
instructions: Begin by heating the olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for about 5-7 minutes until softened and translucent. Stir in the minced garlic and shredded carrot, cooking for another 3-4 minutes until the carrots begin to soften. Next, add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes to deepen its flavor. Add the shredded beetroot to the pot, along with the apple cider vinegar, and stir well to combine. Cook for 5 minutes, allowing the vinegar to interact with the beets and help retain their vibrant color. Pour in the vegetable broth and the water, then add the diced potatoes, shredded cabbage, bay leaf, and whole black peppercorns. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for at least 30-40 minutes, or until all the vegetables are tender. Remove the bay leaf and whole peppercorns if desired before serving. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and ground black pepper as needed. Ladle the hot borscht into bowls and garnish each serving with a dollop of Greek yogurt and a generous sprinkle of fresh dill.

title: Hearty Vegetarian Borscht with Dill and Low-Fat Kefir
ingredients_json: ["450 g Beets, raw, peeled and grated", "500 g Cabbage, white, raw, thinly shredded", "200 g Carrots, raw, grated", "150 g Onion, yellow, raw, finely chopped", "15 g Garlic, raw, minced", "300 g Potatoes, raw, peeled and diced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "400 g Crushed tomatoes, canned", "1.5 liter Vegetable broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Apple cider vinegar", "1 tsp Dried dill", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt", "20 g Fresh dill, chopped, for garnish", "150 g Kefir, low-fat, for serving"]
instructions: Begin by finely chopping the onion, mincing the garlic, grating the carrots and beets, and thinly shredding the cabbage. Peel and dice the potatoes into bite-sized pieces. In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and grated carrots, sautéing for about 5-7 minutes until softened and fragrant. Stir in the grated beets and minced garlic, cooking for another 5 minutes, allowing the beets to release some of their color. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth, then add the diced potatoes and shredded cabbage. Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes and cabbage are tender. Stir in the apple cider vinegar, dried dill, black pepper, and salt. Ladle the hot borscht into bowls, topping each serving with a dollop of low-fat kefir and a sprinkle of fresh dill before serving.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Roasted Red Pepper Bruschetta
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole grain baguette", "300 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "200 g Red bell pepper, fresh", "150 g Cherry tomatoes, fresh", "30 g Red onion, fresh", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh", "20 g Basil, fresh", "4 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tbsp Balsamic vinegar", "10 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Slice the red bell pepper in half, carefully remove the seeds, and place the halves cut-side down on a baking sheet. Roast them for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the skin is visibly blistered and slightly charred. Once roasted, transfer the peppers to a bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let them cool for about 10 minutes to loosen the skin, then peel and dice them finely. While the peppers are roasting, season the chicken breast with 1 gram of salt and 0.5 gram of black pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 6-8 minutes per side, ensuring it's fully cooked through. Allow the chicken to rest for a few minutes before dicing it into small, bite-sized pieces. Slice the whole grain baguette into 1 cm thick rounds. Lightly brush one side of each slice with 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Toast the baguette slices in the same oven (or a toaster) for 5-7 minutes until they are golden and crisp. Once toasted, rub the un-oiled side of each slice with a cut garlic clove for added flavor. In a medium mixing bowl, combine the diced roasted red pepper, diced chicken, quartered cherry tomatoes, finely chopped red onion, and freshly chopped basil. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil, balsamic vinegar, fresh lemon juice, the remaining 2 grams of salt, and 0.5 gram of black pepper to create a dressing. Pour this dressing over the chicken and vegetable mixture, tossing gently until everything is well coated. Finally, spoon the generous chicken and bruschetta topping onto each toasted baguette slice. Serve immediately to enjoy the fresh flavors.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea & Tomato Bruschetta with Feta
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole grain baguette", "500 g Cherry tomatoes, ripe", "200 g Chickpeas, canned, drained", "100 g Feta cheese, light", "50 g Red onion, raw", "100 g Cucumber, fresh", "2 clove Garlic, raw", "60 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "10 g Basil, fresh", "30 ml Balsamic vinegar", "3 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). Slice the whole grain baguette into 12-16 even pieces, about 1.5 cm thick. Arrange them on a baking sheet, brush lightly with 15 ml of olive oil, and toast in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, or until golden and slightly crisp. While the bread is toasting, prepare the bruschetta topping. Halve the cherry tomatoes, finely dice the red onion and cucumber, and coarsely chop the fresh basil leaves. In a medium bowl, combine the halved cherry tomatoes, diced red onion, diced cucumber, and drained chickpeas. Mince the garlic cloves and add them to the mixture. Crumble the light feta cheese into the bowl. Drizzle the remaining 45 ml of olive oil and the balsamic vinegar over the mixture, then season with salt and black pepper. Stir gently to combine all ingredients, ensuring the flavors are well distributed. Once the toasted bread is ready, remove it from the oven and allow it to cool slightly. Generously spoon the Mediterranean chickpea and tomato mixture onto each slice of toasted baguette. Serve immediately and enjoy this fresh and vibrant dinner.

title: Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Greek Yogurt Ranch Dip
ingredients_json: ["1 kg Chicken wings, skin on", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Garlic powder", "0.5 tsp Onion powder", "0.5 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.75 tsp Salt, fine", "120 ml Hot sauce, e.g., Frank's RedHot", "1 tbsp Apple cider vinegar", "15 g Butter, unsalted", "1 clove Garlic, fresh", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "2 tbsp Dill, fresh, chopped", "1 tbsp Chives, fresh, chopped", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.25 tsp Onion powder", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "0.25 tsp Salt, fine", "0.125 tsp Black pepper, ground", "150 g Celery sticks", "150 g Carrot sticks"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). Pat the chicken wings thoroughly dry with paper towels to ensure crispiness. In a large bowl, toss the dried chicken wings with olive oil, 1 teaspoon garlic powder, 0.5 teaspoon onion powder, smoked paprika, 0.25 teaspoon black pepper, and 0.75 teaspoon salt until evenly coated. Arrange the wings in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or a wire rack placed over a baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes, then flip the wings and bake for another 20-25 minutes, or until they are golden brown and crispy. While the wings are baking, prepare the Buffalo sauce by melting the butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Remove from heat, then stir in the hot sauce and apple cider vinegar. Once the wings are cooked, transfer them to a large bowl and pour the warm Buffalo sauce over them, tossing gently until each wing is well coated. For the Greek yogurt ranch dip, combine the Greek yogurt, fresh dill, chives, 0.5 teaspoon garlic powder, 0.25 teaspoon onion powder, fresh lemon juice, 0.25 teaspoon salt, and 0.125 teaspoon black pepper in a small bowl; stir until smooth. Serve the Buffalo chicken wings immediately with the Greek yogurt ranch dip and fresh celery and carrot sticks on the side.

title: Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Cooling Greek Yogurt Dip and Crisp Veggies
ingredients_json: ["1 kg Chicken wings, skin-on", "120 ml Hot sauce, e.g., Frank's RedHot", "15 g Butter, unsalted", "5 ml White wine vinegar", "5 g Garlic powder", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table", "200 g Yogurt, Greek, plain, 0% fat", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "5 g Dill, fresh, chopped", "200 g Carrot, raw, peeled", "150 g Celery stalk, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper or foil and place a wire rack on top. Pat the chicken wings thoroughly dry with paper towels; this step is crucial for crispy skin. In a large bowl, season the dry wings with salt and black pepper, ensuring they are evenly coated. Arrange the seasoned wings in a single layer on the wire rack, leaving a little space between each wing for even cooking. Bake for 40-50 minutes, flipping them halfway through, until the wings are golden brown and crispy, and the internal temperature reaches 74°C (165°F). While the wings are baking, prepare the buffalo sauce. In a small saucepan over medium-low heat, melt the butter. Once melted, remove from heat and stir in the hot sauce, white wine vinegar, and garlic powder until well combined. For the cooling dip, combine the Greek yogurt, fresh lemon juice, and chopped dill in a small bowl. Stir well and season with a pinch of salt if desired. Once the wings are cooked, carefully transfer them to a large clean bowl. Pour the prepared buffalo sauce over the hot wings and toss gently until all wings are thoroughly coated. Serve the sauced buffalo wings immediately with the cooling Greek yogurt dip and an ample side of crisp carrot and celery sticks.

title: Baked Lean Buffalo Chicken Wings with Greek Yogurt Blue Cheese Dip
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg Chicken wing, whole (drumettes and flats)", "0.5 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "120 ml Hot sauce, Franks RedHot original", "15 g Butter, unsalted", "5 ml Apple cider vinegar", "2 g Garlic powder", "300 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "30 g Blue cheese, crumbled", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "5 g Chives, fresh, chopped", "200 g Carrot, raw, peeled", "200 g Celery, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Pat the chicken wings thoroughly dry with paper towels to ensure crispy skin, then season them evenly with salt and black pepper. Arrange the wings in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet, ensuring they are not overcrowded, and bake for 45-55 minutes, flipping them halfway through, until they are golden brown and cooked through. While the wings are baking, prepare the buffalo sauce by melting the unsalted butter in a small saucepan over low heat, then stir in the hot sauce, apple cider vinegar, and garlic powder until well combined and warm; remove from heat. For the dip, combine the Greek yogurt, crumbled blue cheese, fresh lemon juice, and chopped chives in a small bowl, stirring until smooth. Once the wings are cooked, transfer them to a large mixing bowl, pour the warm buffalo sauce over them, and toss until all wings are evenly coated. Serve the hot buffalo chicken wings immediately with the creamy Greek yogurt blue cheese dip and fresh carrot and celery sticks.

title: Healthy Beef Bulgogi with Shiitake and Colorful Bell Peppers
ingredients_json: ["500 g Beef sirloin, lean", "60 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "30 ml Water", "1 tbsp Honey, liquid", "1 tbsp Sesame oil, toasted", "20 g Garlic, raw, cloves", "15 g Ginger root, raw", "100 g Pear, Asian, raw", "20 g Spring onion, raw", "150 g Onion, raw", "150 g Shiitake mushrooms, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, green, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "5 g Sesame seeds, toasted"]
instructions: Begin by thinly slicing the beef sirloin against the grain and setting it aside. For the marinade, finely grate the pear, ginger root, and garlic into a medium bowl. Add the low sodium soy sauce, water, liquid honey, and toasted sesame oil to the bowl, then whisk to combine thoroughly. Add half of the sliced spring onion and half of the thinly sliced raw onion to the marinade. Place the thinly sliced beef into the marinade, ensuring all pieces are well coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or for up to 4 hours, to allow the flavors to meld. While the beef marinates, prepare the remaining vegetables by slicing the rest of the onion, bell peppers (red and green), carrots, and shiitake mushrooms into uniform pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat until shimmering. Carefully add the marinated beef, allowing excess marinade to drip off, and stir-fry for 3 to 5 minutes until the beef is browned and cooked through. Remove the cooked beef from the pan and set it aside. Add the remaining sliced onion, carrots, bell peppers, and shiitake mushrooms to the same pan. Stir-fry these vegetables for 5 to 7 minutes, or until they are tender-crisp and vibrant. Return the cooked beef to the pan with the vegetables, tossing everything together for 1 to 2 minutes to ensure it is heated through and well combined. Garnish with the remaining fresh spring onion and toasted sesame seeds before serving immediately, ideally with brown rice or as lettuce wraps.

title: Healthy Beef Bulgogi with Brown Rice and Sautéed Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g Beef sirloin, lean, thinly sliced", "100 ml Low sodium soy sauce", "20 ml Sesame oil", "20 g Garlic clove, minced", "15 g Ginger, fresh, grated", "100 g Pear, Asian, grated", "15 g Honey", "5 g Black pepper, ground", "200 g Onion, yellow, large, sliced", "150 g Carrot, julienned", "150 g Bell pepper, red, sliced", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "150 g Mushroom, cremini, sliced", "300 g Brown rice, uncooked"]
instructions: First, prepare the bulgogi marinade. In a large bowl, combine the low sodium soy sauce, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, grated pear, honey, and black pepper. Add the thinly sliced beef sirloin to the marinade, ensuring all pieces are well coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or preferably 2-4 hours, to allow the flavors to meld. While the beef marinates, cook the brown rice according to package instructions, typically by combining 300 g brown rice with 600 ml water in a pot, bringing to a boil, then reducing heat to low, covering, and simmering for about 40-45 minutes until the water is absorbed and rice is tender. Heat a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add a small amount of neutral oil if needed (e.g., 5 ml rapeseed oil), though the sesame oil in the marinade may suffice. Once hot, add the marinated beef in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding, and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until the beef is cooked through and slightly caramelized. Remove the cooked beef from the pan and set aside. In the same wok, add the sliced onion and julienned carrot, and sauté for 3-4 minutes until they begin to soften. Next, add the sliced red bell pepper and sliced cremini mushrooms, continuing to cook for another 3-5 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Finally, return the cooked beef to the wok with the vegetables. Add the fresh spinach and toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until the spinach wilts. Serve the healthy beef bulgogi immediately with the cooked brown rice.

title: Lean Beef Bulgogi with Shiitake and Bell Peppers
ingredients_json: ["300 g Beef sirloin, lean, thinly sliced", "100 g Onion, yellow, sliced", "100 g Carrot, raw, julienned", "150 g Bell pepper, red, sliced", "100 g Shiitake mushrooms, fresh, sliced", "50 g Scallions, chopped", "200 g Brown rice, uncooked", "60 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "15 ml Sesame oil, toasted", "12 g Garlic, fresh, crushed", "20 g Ginger, fresh, grated", "100 g Pear, Asian, grated", "15 g Honey", "10 ml Rice vinegar", "5 g Sesame seeds, toasted", "5 ml Olive oil"]
instructions: First, prepare the marinade by combining the low-sodium soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, crushed fresh garlic, grated fresh ginger, grated Asian pear, honey, and rice vinegar in a medium bowl. Whisk everything together until well combined. Add the thinly sliced beef sirloin to the marinade, ensuring all pieces are thoroughly coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours, allowing the flavors to penetrate the meat. While the beef marinates, cook the brown rice according to the package instructions. Heat a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat and add the olive oil. Add the sliced yellow onions, julienned carrots, and sliced red bell pepper to the hot pan. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the vegetables are slightly tender-crisp. Incorporate the sliced shiitake mushrooms and continue to stir-fry for another 2 to 3 minutes. Once cooked, remove the vegetables from the pan and set them aside. Increase the heat to high. Carefully add the marinated beef to the hot pan in a single layer, making sure not to overcrowd it; you may need to cook in batches. Sear the beef for 2 to 3 minutes per side until it is browned and cooked through. Once all the beef is cooked, return it to the pan. Pour in any remaining marinade and bring it to a simmer, cooking for 1 to 2 minutes to slightly reduce the sauce. Add the stir-fried vegetables back into the pan with the beef and toss everything together to combine and heat through for about 1 minute. Finally, stir in most of the chopped scallions. Serve the bulgogi immediately over the cooked brown rice, garnished with the remaining chopped scallions and toasted sesame seeds.

title: Lean Beef Bulgogi with Sesame Vegetables and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g Beef sirloin, lean, thinly sliced", "60 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "40 g Honey, natural", "30 ml Sesame oil", "16 g Garlic, fresh, minced (approx. 4 cloves)", "20 g Ginger, fresh, grated", "100 g Pear, Asian, grated", "1 dl Water", "150 g Onion, yellow, sliced", "150 g Carrot, fresh, julienned", "150 g Bell pepper, red, sliced", "100 g Mushrooms, white, sliced", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "9 g Sesame seeds, toasted", "400 g Rice, brown, cooked"]

Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Cook the beef in batches if necessary, to avoid overcrowding the pan, until browned and cooked through, about 3-5 minutes per batch. Remove the cooked beef from the pan and set aside. Add the sliced yellow onion, julienned carrot, sliced red bell pepper, and sliced mushrooms to the same pan. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Return the cooked beef to the pan with the vegetables. Add the fresh spinach and cook until it wilts, about 2-3 minutes. Toss everything together to combine. Serve the lean beef bulgogi immediately over the cooked brown rice, garnished with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Lean Beef Bulgogi with Mixed Vegetables and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g Sirloin steak, lean, thinly sliced", "150 g Brown rice, uncooked", "60 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "15 ml Sesame oil, toasted", "15 g Garlic, minced", "10 g Ginger, fresh, grated", "100 g Pear, grated", "10 g Honey", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "150 g Onion, sliced", "150 g Carrots, julienned", "150 g Red bell pepper, sliced", "100 g Cremini mushrooms, sliced", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "5 g Sesame seeds, toasted, for garnish"]
instructions: Begin by preparing the marinade for the beef. In a medium bowl, combine the low sodium soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, grated pear, honey, and black pepper. Add the thinly sliced sirloin steak to the marinade, ensuring all pieces are well coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours for best flavor. While the beef marinates, cook the brown rice according to package instructions, typically by rinsing the rice thoroughly, then combining with 300 ml of water in a pot, bringing to a boil, reducing heat to low, covering, and simmering for 35-40 minutes until water is absorbed and rice is tender. Set aside. Heat a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, add half of the marinated beef in a single layer, ensuring not to overcrowd the pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side until browned, then remove and set aside. Repeat with the remaining beef. In the same wok, add the sliced onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened. Add the julienned carrots and sliced red bell pepper, cooking for another 5 minutes until they start to soften but still retain some crunch. Stir in the sliced mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes until they release their moisture. Return the cooked beef to the wok with the vegetables. Add the fresh spinach and toss everything together, cooking just until the spinach wilts, about 1-2 minutes. title: Lean Turkey and Spinach Burgers with Avocado-Lime Greek Yogurt Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Whole wheat breadcrumbs", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "10 g Garlic, raw", "2 g Paprika powder", "2 g Cumin powder", "4 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "4 pieces Whole wheat burger bun", "200 g Tomato, red, raw", "100 g Lettuce, romaine", "200 g Avocado, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "10 g Lemon juice"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and garlic. In a large bowl, combine the lean turkey mince, finely chopped onion and garlic, fresh spinach, whole wheat breadcrumbs, raw egg, paprika powder, cumin powder, 2 grams of salt, and black pepper. Mix everything thoroughly with your hands until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Divide the mixture into four equal portions and form them into burger patties, about 2 cm thick. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook the turkey patties for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown and cooked through with an internal temperature of 74°C. While the burgers are cooking, prepare the avocado-lime sauce by mashing the avocado in a small bowl. Stir in the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and remaining 2 grams of salt. Slice the tomatoes and wash the lettuce. Lightly toast the whole wheat burger buns. Assemble the burgers by placing a cooked patty on the bottom half of each bun, topping with lettuce, tomato slices, and a generous dollop of the avocado-lime Greek yogurt sauce before adding the top bun.

title: Mediterranean Turkey & Feta Burgers with Whole Wheat Buns
ingredients_json: ["300 g Turkey mince, lean", "50 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "30 g Spinach, fresh", "1 piece Egg, raw, medium", "10 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat", "5 ml Olive oil", "2 pieces Whole wheat burger bun", "60 g Tomato, fresh", "30 g Lettuce, Romaine", "20 g Red onion, fresh", "5 g Dijon mustard", "5 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "2 g Garlic powder", "2 g Dried oregano", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt"]

Place a cooked turkey patty on the bottom bun, then layer with Romaine lettuce, tomato slices, and red onion. Top with the other half of the bun and serve immediately.

title: Lean Turkey & Avocado Burgers on Whole Wheat Buns
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "1 piece Egg, raw", "30 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat", "5 g Garlic, raw, minced", "10 g Onion, white, raw, diced", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt, table", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "4 pieces Burger buns, whole wheat", "80 g Lettuce, iceberg", "160 g Tomato, red, raw, sliced", "80 g Avocado, raw, sliced", "4 slices Cheese, light, 15% fat", "4 tbsp Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "5 g Chives, fresh, chopped"]

title: Lean Turkey & Spinach Burgers with Whole Wheat Buns and Avocado

title: Zesty Cod Ceviche with Avocado and Red Bell Pepper

title: Healthy Chicken Adobo with Bell Peppers and Brown Rice

title: Healthy Verde Chicken Chilaquiles with Avocado Crema
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, raw, boneless, skinless", "12 pieces Corn tortillas, yellow, small", "500 g Tomatillos, raw", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Jalapeño pepper, raw", "10 g Cilantro, fresh", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "120 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "50 g Cotija cheese, crumbled", "200 g Avocado, fresh", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "5 ml Lime, juice, fresh", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions:
Begin by preparing the tomatillo sauce: Remove the papery husks from the tomatillos, rinse them thoroughly, and place them in a medium saucepan along with the peeled onion (cut into quarters) and the jalapeño pepper (stem removed, deseeded if you prefer less heat). Cover the vegetables with water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the tomatillos are soft and their color has lightened to a pale green. Drain the vegetables, reserving approximately 60 ml of the cooking liquid. Transfer the cooked tomatillos, onion, jalapeño, raw garlic cloves, fresh cilantro, 15 ml olive oil, chicken broth, and the reserved cooking liquid to a blender. Blend until the sauce is smooth and vibrant. Season the sauce with 1 gram of salt and 0.5 gram of black pepper, then set aside.

Next, prepare the chicken: Season the chicken breast with the remaining 1 gram of salt and 0.5 gram of black pepper. Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Place the seasoned chicken breast in the hot pan and cook for 6-8 minutes per side, or until it is thoroughly cooked through and golden brown. Remove the chicken from the pan, allow it to rest for a few minutes, then shred it into bite-sized pieces using two forks.

Now, prepare the tortilla chips: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F) or your air fryer to 180°C (350°F). Cut each small corn tortilla into 6-8 triangular wedges. Arrange the tortilla wedges in a single layer on a baking sheet. Lightly spray them with cooking oil spray, or gently brush with a tiny amount of olive oil. Bake or air fry for 8-12 minutes, making sure to flip them halfway through, until they are crisp and golden brown. Monitor them closely to prevent burning.

Assemble the chilaquiles: In a large skillet or wide pot, heat the prepared tomatillo sauce over medium heat until it begins to gently simmer. Add the baked tortilla wedges and the shredded chicken to the simmering sauce. Gently toss everything to coat the tortillas and chicken evenly with the sauce. Continue to cook for 2-3 minutes, allowing the tortillas to soften slightly while still retaining some texture, and for the sauce to thicken slightly.

Serve immediately: Divide the hot chilaquiles among 4 individual plates. Garnish each serving generously with crumbled cotija cheese, fresh slices of avocado, a dollop of low-fat Greek yogurt (as a healthy alternative to traditional crema), and a final squeeze of fresh lime juice for brightness. Enjoy your healthy and flavorful dinner!

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Asparagus and Red Wine Reduction

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Roasted Asparagus and Red Wine Shallot Reduction

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Roasted Asparagus and Sweet Potato Mash

title: Grilled Flank Steak with Fresh Chimichurri and Roasted Asparagus

title: Pan-Seared Flat Iron Steak with Rosemary Potatoes and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["500 g Flat iron steak, raw", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "400 g Potato, raw, unspecified", "200 g Asparagus, raw", "2 piece Garlic clove, raw", "5 g Rosemary, fresh", "3 g Thyme, fresh"]
instructions: Begin by preheating your oven to 200°C. Thoroughly wash the potatoes and cut them into quarters. In a mixing bowl, toss the potato quarters with 5 ml of olive oil, half of the fresh rosemary, 1 gram of salt, and 0.5 grams of black pepper. Spread the seasoned potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes. While the potatoes are roasting, prepare the asparagus by trimming the woody ends. In the same mixing bowl, toss the asparagus spears with 5 ml of olive oil, the minced garlic, 0.5 grams of salt, and the remaining 0.5 grams of black pepper. After the potatoes have roasted for 25 minutes, add the seasoned asparagus to the baking sheet and continue roasting for another 10-12 minutes, or until both the potatoes are tender and lightly browned, and the asparagus is crisp-tender. While the vegetables finish roasting, pat the flat iron steak very dry with paper towels to ensure a good sear, then season generously on both sides with the remaining 0.5 grams of salt and the rest of the fresh rosemary. Heat a heavy-bottomed skillet or cast-iron pan over medium-high heat until very hot, then add the remaining 5 ml of olive oil. Carefully place the seasoned steak in the hot pan and sear for 3-4 minutes per side for a medium-rare doneness, or adjust cooking time to your preference. For added aroma, you can add a sprig of fresh thyme to the pan during the last minute of cooking. Once cooked, transfer the steak to a cutting board and let it rest for at least 5-10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain. Serve the sliced flat iron steak immediately with the roasted rosemary potatoes and asparagus.

title: Zesty Lemon Chicken and Asparagus Whole Wheat Flatbreads
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Whole wheat flatbread, large", "200 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "150 g Asparagus, raw", "100 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "50 g Red onion, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 unit Lemon, medium, raw", "60 g Mozzarella cheese, light", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Pat the chicken breast dry and slice it into thin strips. In a medium bowl, toss the chicken strips with 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil, minced garlic, half of the lemon juice, lemon zest, dried oregano, and a pinch of salt and black pepper. Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus and chop the spears into 2-3 cm pieces. Halve the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion. On a baking tray, spread out the seasoned chicken, asparagus, cherry tomatoes, and red onion. Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender-crisp. While the chicken and vegetables are roasting, grate the mozzarella cheese. Once cooked, evenly distribute the roasted chicken and vegetables over the two whole wheat flatbreads. Sprinkle the grated mozzarella cheese over the toppings. Return the flatbreads to the oven for another 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the flatbread edges are lightly crisped. Serve immediately with an extra squeeze of fresh lemon juice if desired.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Halloumi Flatbreads with Tzatziki
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Flatbread, whole wheat", "300 g Chicken breast, raw, without skin", "150 g Halloumi cheese, grilled", "200 g Yogurt, Greek style, low fat, plain", "1 piece Cucumber, raw (approx 150g)", "2 pieces Tomato, raw (approx 200g)", "1 piece Bell pepper, red, raw (approx 150g)", "0.5 piece Onion, red, raw (approx 50g)", "2 cloves Garlic, raw (approx 6g)", "30 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "30 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "15 g Parsley, fresh", "10 g Mint, fresh", "2 g Oregano, dried", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Pepper, black, ground"]
instructions: Dice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. In a bowl, toss the chicken with 15 ml of olive oil, 1 gram of salt, 0.5 gram of black pepper, and 1 gram of dried oregano. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside. Slice the halloumi cheese and grill or pan-fry until golden brown on both sides. Finely dice the cucumber, tomatoes, red bell pepper, and red onion. Roughly chop the fresh parsley and mint. For the tzatziki sauce, grate half of the cucumber and squeeze out excess water. Mince the garlic cloves. In a small bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, grated cucumber, minced garlic, 15 ml of lemon juice, 1 gram of dried oregano, 1 gram of salt, and 0.5 gram of black pepper. Stir well. Warm the whole wheat flatbreads in a dry pan or microwave for about 30 seconds each. To assemble, spread a generous amount of tzatziki sauce onto each warm flatbread. Top with the cooked chicken, grilled halloumi, and a mix of the diced vegetables. Garnish with additional fresh parsley and mint if desired, then serve immediately.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken and Roasted Vegetable Whole Wheat Flatbreads
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Flatbread, whole wheat", "200 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Courgette, raw", "50 g Onion, red, raw", "1 dl Hummus, classic", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "5 g Oregano, fresh", "5 g Parsley, fresh", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Slice the chicken fillet into thin strips, dice the red bell pepper and courgette, and thinly slice the red onion. In a bowl, toss the chicken strips with 1 teaspoon of olive oil, half of the lemon juice, 2 grams of chopped fresh oregano, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Spread the chicken and diced vegetables evenly on a baking tray. Roast in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender-crisp. While the chicken and vegetables are roasting, warm the whole wheat flatbreads in a dry pan over medium heat for 1-2 minutes per side until slightly pliable, or in the oven for a few minutes. Once the flatbreads are warm, spread an even layer of hummus over each. Top with the roasted chicken and vegetables. Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and lemon juice, then sprinkle with the remaining fresh oregano and chopped fresh parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Hummus Flatbreads with Feta
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Flatbread, whole wheat", "200 g Chicken breast, skinless", "100 g Hummus, plain", "100 g Cucumber", "100 g Tomato", "50 g Red onion", "50 g Bell pepper, red", "30 g Feta cheese, light", "10 g Parsley, fresh", "5 g Mint, fresh", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Pat the chicken breast dry and season thoroughly with salt and black pepper. Heat 5 ml of olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 6-8 minutes per side, or until it is fully cooked through and beautifully golden brown. Once cooked, remove the chicken from the pan, allow it to rest for a few minutes, then shred or slice it into thin, bite-sized pieces. While the chicken cooks, prepare the vegetables: dice the cucumber, tomato, and red bell pepper into small, uniform pieces, and thinly slice the red onion. Roughly chop the fresh parsley and mint. In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining 10 ml of olive oil and the fresh lemon juice to create a light dressing. Warm the whole wheat flatbreads in the preheated oven for 2-3 minutes until they are soft and pliable. Spread an even layer of plain hummus over each warmed flatbread, covering the surface. Arrange the shredded chicken evenly over the hummus base. Top generously with the diced cucumber, tomato, red bell pepper, and thinly sliced red onion. Crumble the light feta cheese over all the toppings. Drizzle the prepared lemon-herb dressing evenly over the flatbreads and finish by sprinkling with the chopped fresh parsley and mint before serving immediately as a delicious and healthy dinner.

title: Healthy & Hearty French Onion Soup with Whole Wheat Croutons
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg Onion, yellow, raw", "20 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "12 g Garlic, raw, cloves", "150 ml White wine, dry, 12% alcohol", "1.2 liter Vegetable broth, low sodium", "15 g Wheat flour, whole grain", "1 g Thyme, dried", "1 piece Bay leaf, dried", "3 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "120 g Baguette, whole wheat, part-baked", "100 g Gruyere cheese, 45% fat, unspecified", "5 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Begin by thinly slicing the yellow onions. In a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-low heat. Add the sliced onions along with a small pinch of salt. Cook the onions slowly for 45 to 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are deeply caramelized to a rich golden-brown color. This step is crucial for developing the soup's characteristic flavor. Add the minced garlic and cook for another 2 minutes until it becomes fragrant. Sprinkle the whole wheat flour over the caramelized onions and stir well, cooking for 1 minute to toast the flour lightly. Pour in the white wine (or additional vegetable broth if preferred) and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot with a wooden spoon, letting it simmer for 2-3 minutes to reduce. Now, add the vegetable broth, dried thyme, bay leaf, remaining salt, and black pepper. Bring the soup to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it cook for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld beautifully. While the soup simmers, preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Slice the whole wheat baguette into 2 cm thick rounds and toast them in the oven until they are lightly golden and crisp to form the croutons. Once the soup has finished simmering, remove the bay leaf. Ladle the hot soup into individual oven-safe bowls. Place one or two toasted baguette slices on top of each bowl of soup, then sprinkle generously with grated Gruyere cheese. Carefully transfer the bowls to the oven or under a broiler (watching closely) for 3-5 minutes, until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and beautifully golden brown. Serve immediately, optionally garnished with fresh chopped parsley.

title: Hearty & Healthy French Onion Soup with Whole Grain Croutons
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Onion, yellow, raw", "30 ml Olive oil", "2 clove Garlic, raw", "100 ml White wine, dry", "1.5 liter Vegetable broth, low sodium", "10 g Whole wheat flour", "2 piece Bay leaf", "5 g Thyme, dried", "5 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "100 g Whole wheat baguette", "80 g Gruyere cheese", "10 ml Balsamic vinegar"]

Once caramelized, mince the garlic and add it to the pot, cooking for another minute until fragrant. Sprinkle the whole wheat flour over the onions and stir well, cooking for 2 minutes to toast the flour. Deglaze the pot with the dry white wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Bring the soup to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and let it cook for at least 30 minutes, or up to an hour, allowing the flavors to meld. Season with the remaining salt and black pepper to taste. While the soup simmers, preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Slice the whole wheat baguette into 1 cm thick rounds. Place them on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for about 5-7 minutes until lightly golden and crisp. When ready to serve, preheat your broiler. Ladle the hot soup into oven-safe bowls. Float a few whole grain baguette slices on top of each bowl and sprinkle generously with the shredded Gruyere cheese. Place the bowls under the broiler for 2-4 minutes, watching carefully, until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Hearty Whole Wheat French Onion Soup with Reduced-Fat Gruyère
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Onion, yellow, raw, thinly sliced", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "1 dl Red wine, dry, for cooking", "1.5 liter Broth, vegetable, low sodium", "1 tsp Thyme, dried", "1 piece Bay leaf, dried", "4 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "4 slices Bread, whole wheat baguette (approx. 100g total)", "100 g Gruyere cheese, reduced fat (15% fat), grated"]

Pour in the low-sodium vegetable broth, then add the dried thyme, bay leaf, salt, and black pepper. Bring the soup to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat, cover, and let it simmer for at least 20 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. While the soup simmers, preheat your oven broiler. Arrange the slices of whole wheat baguette on a baking sheet and toast them lightly until golden. Ladle the hot soup into four oven-safe bowls. Top each bowl with a slice of toasted whole wheat baguette, and then generously sprinkle with the grated reduced-fat Gruyère cheese. Carefully place the bowls under the preheated broiler for 3-5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and beautifully golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Classic French Onion Soup with Whole Wheat Croutons
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Onion, yellow, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "15 g Butter, unsalted", "10 g Whole wheat flour", "120 ml White wine, dry, for cooking", "1.5 l Beef broth, low sodium", "5 g Fresh thyme, sprigs", "1 piece Bay leaf", "0.5 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "100 g Whole wheat baguette", "70 g Gruyère cheese, grated"]

Deglaze the pot with white wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom, and let it simmer for 2-3 minutes until the wine has mostly evaporated. Pour in the low-sodium beef broth, add the fresh thyme sprigs and bay leaf, then bring the soup to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook for at least 30 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld. title: Air-Fried Crispy Herb Chicken with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "10 g Paprika powder", "5 g Garlic powder", "5 g Onion powder", "5 g Dried thyme", "5 g Dried oregano", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "30 ml Water", "15 ml Olive oil, spray", "500 g Sweet potato, raw, peeled", "300 g Green beans, fresh", "10 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your air fryer to 190°C. In a shallow dish, combine the whole wheat flour, paprika powder, garlic powder, onion powder, dried thyme, dried oregano, 3g salt, and 1g black pepper, mixing well. In another shallow dish, whisk the two eggs with 30ml water until combined. Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels to ensure a crispy coating. Dip each chicken breast first into the egg mixture, ensuring it's fully coated, then dredge it in the seasoned flour mixture, pressing gently to make sure the coating adheres well to all sides. Place the coated chicken breasts in the air fryer basket, ensuring they are in a single layer without overcrowding; you may need to cook in batches depending on the size of your air fryer. Lightly spray the chicken with olive oil. Air fry for 18-22 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the chicken is golden brown, crispy, and cooked through with an internal temperature of 74°C. While the chicken cooks, prepare the sweet potatoes and green beans. Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into wedges. Toss them with 10ml extra virgin olive oil, 2g salt, and 1g black pepper, then roast them alongside the chicken if your air fryer allows or bake them in a conventional oven at 200°C for 25-30 minutes until tender. Steam or boil the green beans until tender-crisp, about 5-7 minutes. Once the chicken is done, serve immediately with the roasted sweet potato wedges and steamed green beans.

title: Crispy Air-Fried Chicken with Tangy Cabbage Slaw
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "30 ml Milk, low fat", "2.5 g Paprika powder, ground", "1 g Garlic powder", "1 g Onion powder", "1 g Dried thyme", "2.5 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "10 ml Olive oil", "250 g White cabbage, raw", "120 g Carrot, raw", "60 g Red onion, raw", "30 ml Apple cider vinegar", "10 ml Olive oil", "5 g Dijon mustard", "5 g Honey", "0.5 g Salt", "0.2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Begin by preparing the chicken fillets. If they are thick, slice them horizontally to create thinner cutlets of even thickness. Set up a breading station with three shallow dishes: one for whole wheat flour, one for a mixture of the egg and low-fat milk, and one for the whole wheat breadcrumbs combined with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, dried thyme, 2.5 g of salt, and 0.5 g of black pepper. Dredge each chicken fillet first in the flour, shaking off any excess, then dip it into the egg wash, ensuring it's fully coated, and finally press it firmly into the seasoned breadcrumbs until well-covered. Lightly spray or brush the coated chicken with 10 ml of olive oil. Preheat your air fryer to 190°C. Place the breaded chicken in a single layer in the air fryer basket, ensuring not to overcrowd it. Cook for 15-20 minutes, flipping halfway through, or until the chicken is golden brown, crispy, and cooked through to an internal temperature of 74°C. While the chicken cooks, prepare the tangy cabbage slaw. Thinly slice the white cabbage and red onion, and grate the carrot. In a separate bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, 10 ml of olive oil, Dijon mustard, honey, 0.5 g of salt, and 0.2 g of black pepper to create the dressing. Combine the sliced cabbage, grated carrot, and sliced red onion in a large bowl, then pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss until everything is well coated. Once the chicken is ready, serve it immediately alongside the fresh and tangy cabbage slaw.

title: Crispy Herb-Crusted Chicken with Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "2 pieces Egg, raw, whole, unspecified", "50 ml Milk, cow's, 1.5% fat", "100 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat", "20 g Parmesan cheese, hard, grated", "3 g Garlic powder", "3 g Onion powder", "3 g Smoked paprika powder", "3 g Dried oregano", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt, table, fine", "40 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "600 g Sweet potato, raw, with skin", "150 g Mixed green salad leaves", "20 ml Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C (fan 180°C). Wash and pat dry the chicken breasts. Cut each breast in half lengthwise to create thinner cutlets. In a shallow bowl, whisk the eggs with milk. In another shallow bowl, combine the whole wheat breadcrumbs, grated Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, dried oregano, black pepper, and 2g of the salt. Dip each chicken piece first into the egg mixture, allowing excess to drip off, then dredge thoroughly in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to ensure an even coating. Place the coated chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Drizzle 10 ml of olive oil over the chicken. Wash the sweet potatoes thoroughly and cut them into wedges (about 1.5 cm thick). In a large bowl, toss the sweet potato wedges with the remaining 30 ml of olive oil and 1g of salt. Spread the wedges in a single layer on a separate baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake the sweet potato wedges for 20 minutes, then flip them and continue baking for another 15-20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned. Bake the chicken for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature reaches 74°C). The cooking times may overlap or require slight adjustment depending on your oven. While the chicken and sweet potatoes are baking, prepare a simple salad by tossing the mixed green salad leaves with lemon juice. Serve the crispy herb-crusted chicken immediately with the roasted sweet potato wedges and fresh green salad.

title: Air-Fried Paprika Chicken with Roasted Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "1 piece Egg, raw, unspecified", "5 g Paprika powder", "2 g Garlic powder", "2 g Onion powder", "5 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "15 ml Olive oil", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "120 g Quinoa, uncooked", "240 ml Water", "15 ml Lemon juice"]
instructions: First, prepare the quinoa by rinsing it thoroughly under cold water. Combine the rinsed quinoa with 240 ml of water in a small saucepan, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until all water is absorbed. Remove from heat and let it sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Next, preheat your air fryer to 200°C (400°F) and your oven to 200°C (400°F). Cut the chicken breasts into 1.5 cm thick cutlets. In a shallow dish, whisk the egg. In another shallow dish, combine the whole wheat flour, paprika powder, garlic powder, onion powder, 3 g of the salt, and the black pepper. Dip each chicken cutlet first into the egg, then dredge thoroughly in the flour mixture, ensuring it's fully coated. Lightly spray the air fryer basket with olive oil, then arrange the chicken in a single layer, making sure not to overcrowd. Air fry for 10-15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature reaches 74°C or 165°F). While the chicken air fries, chop the broccoli into florets. Toss the broccoli with 10 ml of olive oil, the remaining 2 g of salt, and a dash of pepper on a baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until tender-crisp and slightly charred. Once everything is ready, squeeze the lemon juice over the cooked chicken and roasted broccoli. Serve the air-fried paprika chicken immediately alongside the fluffy quinoa and roasted broccoli.

title: Lean Chicken and Veggie Brown Fried Rice
ingredients_json: ["200 g Chicken breast, raw", "250 g Brown rice, cooked", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "100 g Carrot, raw", "80 g Green peas, frozen", "80 g Broccoli florets, raw", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "10 g Ginger root, raw", "15 ml Rapeseed oil", "30 ml Soy sauce, reduced sodium", "5 ml Sesame oil", "5 g Green onion, raw"]
instructions: First, dice the chicken breast into small, bite-sized pieces. Mince the garlic and ginger finely. If you are not using pre-cooked rice, cook the brown rice according to package directions and let it cool completely; day-old rice works best for achieving the desired fried rice texture. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large wok or a spacious non-stick pan over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the diced chicken and stir-fry, breaking up any clumps, until it is cooked through and lightly browned, typically 5-7 minutes. Push the cooked chicken to one side of the pan, then add the minced garlic and ginger to the empty side and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until they become fragrant. Next, add the diced carrots and broccoli florets to the pan, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until they are slightly tender-crisp. Incorporate the frozen green peas and continue to stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Create a small well in the center of the vegetables, crack the egg directly into it, and quickly scramble it until just set, then thoroughly mix it into the chicken and vegetables. Finally, add the cooled brown rice to the pan. Pour in the reduced sodium soy sauce and sesame oil. Stir and toss everything together vigorously for 3-5 minutes, ensuring the rice is heated through and every grain is well-combined with all the ingredients and flavors. Garnish with freshly chopped green onion before serving, if desired.

title: Lean Chicken and Edamame Brown Fried Rice
ingredients_json: ["150 g Chicken breast, raw", "150 g Brown rice, uncooked", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "100 g Edamame beans, shelled, frozen", "80 g Carrot, raw", "80 g Broccoli, raw", "50 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "10 g Ginger, fresh", "1 tbsp Rapeseed oil", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "2 pcs Scallion, raw"]
instructions: First, rinse the brown rice thoroughly and cook it according to package directions, typically using a 1:2 ratio of rice to water. Mince the garlic and ginger, then dice the carrot, broccoli florets, and red bell pepper into small, uniform pieces. In a large wok or frying pan, heat half of the rapeseed oil over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned, then remove it from the pan and set aside. Beat the eggs lightly, then pour them into the hot pan, scrambling until just set. Remove the scrambled egg and chop it into smaller pieces. Add the remaining rapeseed oil to the wok. Add the minced garlic and ginger, stir-frying for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced carrots, broccoli, and red bell pepper, and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until they start to tender-crisp. Add the frozen edamame beans and continue to stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Return the cooked chicken and cooled brown rice to the wok. Pour in the reduced sodium soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss everything together, breaking up any clumps of rice, ensuring all ingredients are well combined and heated through, about 3-5 minutes. Finally, stir in the scrambled egg. Garnish with chopped scallions before serving.

title: Wholesome Chicken and Broccoli Brown Rice Fried Rice
ingredients_json: ["200 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "300 g Brown rice, cooked, cold", "1 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Broccoli florets, raw", "80 g Carrot, raw", "70 g Red bell pepper, raw", "50 g Green peas, frozen", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "10 g Ginger, fresh", "30 g Spring onion, raw", "22.5 ml Rapeseed oil", "30 ml Soy sauce, reduced sodium", "5 ml Sesame oil", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]

Push the vegetables to one side of the wok, then crack the egg into the empty space. Scramble the egg quickly until just set, then break it into smaller pieces and mix it thoroughly with the vegetables. Add the cold cooked brown rice and frozen green peas to the wok. Pour in the reduced-sodium soy sauce and sesame oil. Return the cooked chicken to the wok. Stir and toss everything together thoroughly, ensuring the rice is heated through and well-combined with all the ingredients and seasonings; this step typically takes about 3-5 minutes. title: Healthy Chicken and Brown Rice Fried Rice with Edamame
ingredients_json: ["150 g Brown rice, uncooked", "300 ml Water", "200 g Chicken breast, raw, boneless, skinless", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "0.5 tsp Sesame oil, dark", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Broccoli florets, raw", "50 g Peas, frozen", "50 g Edamame beans, shelled, frozen", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "1 cm Ginger, fresh", "1 tbsp Rapeseed oil", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Rice vinegar", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "10 g Spring onion, raw"]
instructions: First, cook the brown rice according to package directions, typically by combining 150g rice with 300ml water in a saucepan, bringing to a boil, then reducing heat to low, covering, and simmering for 30-40 minutes until water is absorbed. title: Healthy Chicken and Vegetable Brown Rice Stir-Fry

title: Healthy Spinach Gnocchi with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes and Basil Pesto

title: Whole Wheat Potato Gnocchi with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potato, raw, unspecified", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "1 piece Egg, raw", "3 g Salt, table", "400 g Cherry tomato, raw", "150 g Spinach, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "30 ml Olive oil", "50 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "20 g Basil, fresh", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Begin by boiling the potatoes until they are very tender, about 20-25 minutes depending on their size. Drain them well and allow them to cool slightly. In a baking dish, combine the cherry tomatoes, 15 ml of olive oil, two minced garlic cloves, and 1g of salt and 1g of black pepper. Roast for 15-20 minutes, or until the tomatoes are slightly burst and caramelized. While the tomatoes are roasting, bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully drop the gnocchi into the boiling water in batches. Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they float to the surface. Once they float, let them cook for another 30 seconds, then remove them with a slotted spoon and set aside. In a large pan, heat the remaining 15 ml of olive oil over medium heat. Add the remaining minced garlic clove and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Pour in the vegetable broth and add the roasted cherry tomatoes to the pan. Gently add the cooked gnocchi to the sauce, tossing to coat. title: Mediterranean Gnocchi with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes and Fresh Spinach

title: Hearty Lean Beef and Bell Pepper Goulash
