Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly, melted, and lightly golden brown. Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving to allow it to set properly.

title: Healthy Ginger-Garlic Chicken Lettuce Wraps
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken mince, lean", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, unspecified", "20 g Ginger, raw, unspecified", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "50 g Water chestnuts, canned, drained", "50 g Spring onion, raw", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "1 tsp Honey", "8 leaves Lettuce, butterhead, raw", "1 tbsp Peanuts, dry roasted, unsalted, chopped"]
instructions: Finely mince the garlic and ginger. Dice the carrot and red bell pepper into small pieces. Slice the water chestnuts thinly and chop the spring onions, separating the white and green parts. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the lean chicken mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat. Add the minced garlic and ginger to the pan and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the diced carrot, red bell pepper, and the white parts of the spring onion. Cook for 3-4 minutes until the vegetables are slightly softened but still retain some crunch. In a small bowl, whisk together the low sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and honey. Pour the sauce over the chicken and vegetable mixture in the pan. Add the sliced water chestnuts and cook for another 1-2 minutes, stirring to coat everything evenly in the sauce. Remove from heat and stir in the green parts of the spring onion and chopped peanuts. Arrange the butterhead lettuce leaves on a platter. To serve, spoon a portion of the chicken mixture into each lettuce leaf and fold or roll to eat.

title: Ginger-Garlic Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Peanut Sauce
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp Olive oil", "400 g Chicken mince, lean", "100 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "6 g Garlic, raw, minced", "10 g Ginger, fresh, grated", "60 g Carrot, raw, grated", "100 g Water chestnuts, canned, sliced", "30 g Spring onion, raw, chopped", "30 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "15 ml Rice vinegar", "5 ml Sesame oil", "300 g Lettuce, butterhead, leaves separated", "45 g Peanut butter, natural, unsweetened", "30 ml Water", "15 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "5 ml Rice vinegar", "7 g Honey", "2.5 ml Sriracha sauce"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the lean chicken mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it's browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat if necessary. Add the chopped yellow onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the pan and sauté for 3-4 minutes until fragrant and softened. Stir in the grated carrot, sliced water chestnuts, and half of the chopped spring onion. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until vegetables are slightly tender-crisp. Pour in 30 ml of low sodium soy sauce, 15 ml of rice vinegar, and 5 ml of sesame oil, tossing everything to combine well. Cook for 1 minute more until the sauce slightly thickens, then remove from heat. While the filling is cooking, prepare the peanut sauce by whisking together the natural peanut butter, 30 ml of water, 15 ml of low sodium soy sauce, 5 ml of rice vinegar, honey, and sriracha sauce in a small bowl until smooth. If the sauce is too thick, add a tiny bit more water until it reaches your desired consistency. Arrange the butterhead lettuce leaves on a platter. To serve, spoon the warm chicken and vegetable mixture into individual lettuce cups, garnish with the remaining fresh spring onion, and drizzle with or serve the peanut sauce on the side.

title: Spicy Peanut Chicken Lettuce Wraps
ingredients_json: ["500 g Chicken mince, lean", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "15 g Garlic, raw, minced", "10 g Ginger, fresh, peeled, grated", "180 g Bell pepper, red, diced", "150 g Water chestnut, canned, drained and chopped", "60 g Peanut butter, smooth, unsalted", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tbsp Honey", "1 tsp Sriracha sauce", "2 tbsp Water", "1 head Lettuce, butter, separated into leaves", "50 g Spring onion, green part, chopped", "50 g Peanuts, roasted, unsalted, chopped"]
instructions: First, prepare the sauce by whisking together the peanut butter, low sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, sriracha, and water in a small bowl until smooth. Set aside. Next, finely chop the onion, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger. Dice the red bell pepper and finely chop the water chestnuts. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it's browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat. Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the skillet. Sauté for 3-4 minutes until the onion softens and becomes translucent and fragrant. Stir in the diced red bell pepper and chopped water chestnuts, cooking for another 2-3 minutes until slightly tender-crisp. Pour the prepared peanut sauce over the chicken and vegetable mixture, stirring well to coat everything evenly. Let it simmer gently for 2-3 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly. Remove from heat. Arrange the separated lettuce leaves on a platter. Spoon the warm chicken filling into each lettuce cup. Garnish with chopped spring onions and chopped roasted peanuts before serving.

title: Spicy Peanut Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Crunchy Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, raw, without skin", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 cm Ginger root, raw", "1 piece Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "60 g Peanut butter, natural, unsweetened", "3 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar, unseasoned", "1 tbsp Maple syrup, pure", "1 tsp Sriracha sauce", "1 dl Water, tap", "1 head Lettuce, Iceberg, raw", "2 tbsp Coriander, fresh, raw", "1 tbsp Peanuts, dry roasted, unsalted"]
instructions:
Begin by finely dicing the chicken breast into small, bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken to the hot pan and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is no longer pink and is lightly browned. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and set it aside in a bowl.
While the chicken cooks, finely chop the yellow onion, mince the garlic cloves, and grate the fresh ginger root. Add the chopped onion to the same pan and sauté for 3 to 4 minutes until it begins to soften. Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute until fragrant.
Dice the red bell pepper and grate the carrot. Add these vegetables to the pan with the onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook for another 5 to 7 minutes, stirring frequently, until they are slightly tender but still retain a bit of crispness.
In a small bowl, prepare the sauce by whisking together the natural peanut butter, reduced sodium soy sauce, unseasoned rice vinegar, pure maple syrup, sriracha sauce, and water until the mixture is smooth and well combined.
Pour the prepared peanut sauce into the pan with the cooked vegetables. Return the cooked chicken to the pan and stir everything together thoroughly, ensuring all the chicken and vegetables are evenly coated in the sauce. Allow the mixture to simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes, giving the flavors time to meld and the sauce to thicken slightly.
While the chicken mixture simmers, wash and carefully separate the leaves from the head of Iceberg lettuce, ensuring they are dry and intact to form the wraps.
To serve, spoon generous portions of the warm spicy peanut chicken and vegetable mixture into the crisp lettuce cups. Garnish each wrap with a sprinkle of fresh chopped coriander and a few dry roasted, unsalted peanuts for added crunch and flavor. Serve immediately as a satisfying and healthy dinner.

title: Creamy Butternut Squash Macaroni and Cheese with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["250 g Macaroni, whole wheat, dry", "500 g Butternut squash, peeled and diced", "15 ml Olive oil", "100 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, crushed", "30 g Whole wheat flour", "5 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "2 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "150 g Cheddar cheese, mature, grated", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "2 g Nutmeg, ground", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: First, preheat your oven to 190°C. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, add the whole wheat macaroni, and cook according to package directions until al dente. Drain the macaroni and set aside. While the pasta cooks, toss the diced butternut squash with 5 ml of olive oil, a pinch of salt, and pepper on a baking sheet, then roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelised. In a large saucepan, heat the remaining 10 ml of olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 5-7 minutes until softened. Stir in the crushed garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Sprinkle in the whole wheat flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes to create a roux. Gradually whisk in the semi-skimmed milk and chicken broth, continuing to whisk until the sauce thickens and is smooth. Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the grated mature cheddar cheese and parmesan cheese until melted and smooth. Season the cheese sauce with ground nutmeg, salt, and black pepper, adjusting to taste. Add the fresh spinach to the hot cheese sauce and stir until it wilts. Gently fold the cooked macaroni and roasted butternut squash into the cheese sauce until everything is well combined. Pour the entire mixture into a large baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly golden on top. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Butternut Squash and Spinach Macaroni with Reduced-Fat Cheese
ingredients_json: ["300 g Macaroni, whole wheat, dry", "500 g Butternut squash, peeled, deseeded, diced", "500 ml Milk, skimmed", "150 g Cheddar cheese, mature, reduced-fat, grated", "30 g Whole wheat flour", "15 g Olive oil, extra virgin", "100 g Onion, yellow, finely chopped", "10 g Garlic, cloves, minced", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "5 g Dijon mustard", "1 g Nutmeg, ground", "4 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Begin by cooking the butternut squash. Place the diced squash in a saucepan with enough water to cover it and bring to a boil. Cook for 15-20 minutes, or until very tender. Drain the squash and mash it thoroughly with a fork or potato masher, setting it aside. Meanwhile, cook the whole wheat macaroni according to package directions until al dente; drain well and set aside. In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and sauté for 5-7 minutes until softened and translucent. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Sprinkle the whole wheat flour over the onion and garlic mixture, stirring constantly for 1 minute to create a roux. Gradually whisk in the skimmed milk, ensuring no lumps form, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, stirring until it thickens slightly. Reduce the heat to low. Stir in the mashed butternut squash, grated reduced-fat cheddar cheese, Dijon mustard, nutmeg, salt, and black pepper. Continue to stir until the cheese is completely melted and the sauce is smooth and creamy. Add the fresh spinach to the cheese sauce and stir until it wilts, which should only take a couple of minutes. Finally, add the drained whole wheat macaroni to the sauce and toss gently to coat all the pasta evenly. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Butternut Squash and Spinach Macaroni
ingredients_json: ["300 g Macaroni, whole wheat, uncooked", "500 g Butternut squash, peeled and diced", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "5 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "150 g Cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "20 g Flour, whole wheat", "100 g Onion, yellow, finely chopped", "10 g Garlic, minced", "5 g Mustard powder", "1 g Nutmeg, ground", "1.5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Begin by preheating your oven to 180°C. Cook the whole wheat macaroni according to package directions until al dente; drain and set aside. While the pasta cooks, steam or boil the diced butternut squash until very tender, about 10-15 minutes. Drain the squash well, then transfer it to a food processor or use an immersion blender to puree until smooth. In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes until softened, then add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the whole wheat flour and mustard powder, cooking for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. Gradually whisk in the semi-skimmed milk, ensuring no lumps form, and continue whisking until the sauce thickens, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the pureed butternut squash, then add the reduced-fat cheddar cheese and parmesan cheese, stirring until melted and smooth. Season the cheese sauce with nutmeg, salt, and black pepper to taste. Fold in the fresh spinach and cooked macaroni until everything is well combined and the spinach has wilted. Transfer the macaroni and cheese mixture to a large baking dish. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Serve hot.

title: Creamy Baked Whole Wheat Mac and Cheese with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["300 g Macaroni, whole wheat, dry", "6 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "150 g Cheese, mature cheddar, grated", "30 g Cheese, Parmesan, grated", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "30 g Flour, whole wheat", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp Mustard, Dijon", "0.5 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "50 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). Cook the whole wheat macaroni according to package directions until al dente, then drain well and set aside. While the macaroni cooks, melt the unsalted butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the whole wheat flour and cook for about 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, to create a roux. Gradually pour in the semi-skimmed milk, whisking continuously to prevent lumps, until the sauce thickens and starts to bubble. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the grated mature cheddar and Parmesan cheese until melted and smooth. Add the Dijon mustard, ground nutmeg, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine. Fold in the fresh spinach and cook until just wilted. Combine the cooked macaroni with the cheese sauce and spinach mixture, ensuring everything is well coated. Pour the macaroni and cheese into a 2-liter baking dish. Sprinkle the whole wheat breadcrumbs evenly over the top. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the cheese sauce is bubbly. Allow to rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Spinach and Part-Skim Ricotta Manicotti with Zesty Marinara
ingredients_json: ["12 pieces Manicotti shells, dried", "450 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "300 g Spinach, fresh, chopped", "1 piece Egg, large, raw", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece Onion, small, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, crushed", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "680 g Tomato passata", "10 g Basil, fresh, chopped", "5 g Oregano, dried", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Begin by preheating your oven to 190 degrees Celsius. In a large pot, bring generously salted water to a boil and cook the manicotti shells according to package directions until al dente, typically 8-10 minutes. Drain the pasta carefully and rinse with cold water to prevent sticking, then set aside. While the pasta cooks, prepare the filling. If using fresh spinach, ensure it is thoroughly washed and finely chopped; if using frozen, thaw and squeeze out all excess water. In a large mixing bowl, combine the part-skim ricotta cheese, chopped spinach, egg, half of the grated Parmesan cheese, fresh basil, dried oregano, 2 grams of salt, and all of the black pepper. Mix until well combined. Next, prepare the sauce. Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the crushed garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Pour in the tomato passata, add the remaining 1 gram of salt, and bring to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to low and let it cook for at least 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld. To assemble, spread about one-third of the marinara sauce on the bottom of a 23x33 cm baking dish. Carefully fill each cooked manicotti shell with the ricotta-spinach mixture using a spoon or a pastry bag. Arrange the filled manicotti in a single layer over the sauce in the baking dish. Pour the remaining marinara sauce evenly over the filled shells. Sprinkle the remaining Parmesan cheese on top. Cover the baking dish loosely with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly and the cheese is melted and lightly golden. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Healthy Spinach and Ricotta Manicotti with Homemade Marinara
ingredients_json: ["12 pieces Manicotti shells, dried", "500 g Spinach, fresh", "500 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "75 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece Egg, large, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh, minced", "0.5 piece Onion, yellow, finely chopped", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "800 g Canned tomatoes, crushed", "1 dl Water", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Dried basil", "0.75 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "50 g Mozzarella cheese, low-fat, shredded"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the manicotti shells according to package directions until al dente; drain, rinse with cold water to prevent sticking, and set aside. While the pasta cooks, prepare the filling by wilting the fresh spinach in a pan, then squeeze out as much excess water as possible and chop it finely. In a large bowl, combine the part-skim ricotta cheese, finely chopped spinach, 50 g of the Parmesan cheese, the egg, 1 clove of minced garlic, and a pinch of salt and pepper; mix well. For the sauce, heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and the remaining clove of minced garlic, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes. Pour in the crushed canned tomatoes, water, dried oregano, dried basil, and the remaining salt and pepper; bring to a simmer and cook for 15-20 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld. To assemble, spread a thin layer of the tomato sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Carefully fill each manicotti shell with the ricotta-spinach mixture using a spoon or a piping bag, then arrange the filled shells in a single layer in the baking dish. Pour the remaining tomato sauce over the manicotti, ensuring they are well covered. Sprinkle the remaining 25 g of Parmesan cheese and the shredded low-fat mozzarella cheese over the top. Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the sauce is simmering.

title: Healthy Spinach and Ricotta Manicotti with Robust Marinara
ingredients_json: ["12 pieces Manicotti shells", "400 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "300 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece Egg, raw", "2 pieces Garlic cloves", "1 piece Onion, medium", "800 g Crushed tomatoes, canned", "30 g Tomato paste", "30 ml Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried basil", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, low-moisture, part-skim", "100 ml Vegetable broth"]
instructions: Begin by preparing the spinach filling. Wilt the fresh spinach in a hot pan for a few minutes until it collapses, then drain any excess water and finely chop it. In a large bowl, combine the part-skim ricotta cheese, chopped wilted spinach, grated Parmesan cheese, the raw egg, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of black pepper. Mix thoroughly until all ingredients are well combined. Next, prepare the robust marinara sauce. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic cloves. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add the crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, dried oregano, dried basil, the remaining salt, and black pepper. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then reduce heat and let it gently bubble for at least 20 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. While the sauce simmers, cook the manicotti shells according to package instructions until al dente; be careful not to overcook them as they will continue to cook in the oven. Drain and rinse with cold water to prevent sticking. Carefully fill each manicotti shell with the spinach and ricotta mixture using a spoon or a pastry bag. Spread a thin layer of marinara sauce on the bottom of a large oven-safe baking dish. Arrange the filled manicotti shells in a single layer over the sauce. Pour the remaining marinara sauce evenly over the manicotti. Sprinkle the shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese on top. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake in a preheated oven at 190°C (375°F) for 25-30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the sauce is hot. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Garlic Herb Mashed Potatoes with Pan-Seared Chicken Breast and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["800 g Potatoes, raw, white", "400 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "4 cloves Garlic, raw", "10 g Parsley, fresh", "100 ml Milk, skimmed, 0.5% fat", "20 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Begin by peeling and cubing the potatoes, then place them in a large pot and cover with cold water. Add a pinch of salt and bring to a boil, cooking until fork-tender, approximately 15-20 minutes. While the potatoes cook, preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). Wash and chop the broccoli into florets, toss with 10 ml of olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread on a baking sheet and roast for 15-20 minutes, until tender-crisp. Next, pat the chicken breasts dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Heat the remaining 10 ml of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through and golden brown, then remove from heat and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing. Once the potatoes are cooked, drain them thoroughly and return them to the pot. Mash the potatoes with the skimmed milk, minced garlic, and chopped fresh parsley until smooth and creamy. Season the mashed potatoes with salt and pepper to taste. Serve the garlic herb mashed potatoes alongside the sliced pan-seared chicken breast and roasted broccoli.

title: Creamy Garlic Herb Mashed Potatoes with Pan-Seared Chicken Breast and Sautéed Spinach
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potato, white, raw", "300 g Chicken breast, skinless", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "4 pieces Garlic clove, raw", "1.5 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tbsp Chives, fresh, chopped", "2 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Begin by peeling and chopping the potatoes into evenly sized pieces. Place them in a large pot, cover with cold water, and add 1 gram of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are very tender when pierced with a fork. While the potatoes cook, pat the chicken breasts dry and season them generously with 1 gram of salt and the black pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned chicken breasts and sear for 5-7 minutes per side, until they are golden brown and cooked through to an internal temperature of 74 degrees Celsius. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest on a cutting board, covered loosely with foil. In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and the minced garlic. Sauté for about 1 minute until the garlic is fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the fresh spinach to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until it has wilted completely, which usually takes 2-3 minutes. Season the spinach lightly with 1 gram of salt. Drain the cooked potatoes thoroughly and return them to the hot pot. Mash the potatoes using a potato masher, gradually adding the warm semi-skimmed milk until you achieve your desired creamy consistency. Stir in the chopped fresh chives and parsley, along with the remaining 1 gram of salt, mixing well to combine all the flavors. Slice the rested chicken breast into thick pieces. To serve, spoon a generous portion of the creamy garlic herb mashed potatoes onto plates, arrange the sliced chicken breast alongside, and complete the meal with a mound of the sautéed spinach.

title: Creamy Garlic Herb Mashed Potatoes with Lean Chicken Mince and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["800 g Potatoes, raw, peeled", "150 ml Milk, skimmed, 0.1% fat", "50 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "400 g Chicken mince, extra lean, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "200 g Spinach, fresh, raw", "100 ml Chicken broth, low sodium"]
instructions: Begin by peeling and cubing the potatoes. Place them in a large pot, cover with cold water, and add a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook until fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes. While the potatoes are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add the lean chicken mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned throughout. Pour in the low-sodium chicken broth, season with half of the salt and pepper, and let it simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in the fresh spinach until it wilts. Drain the cooked potatoes thoroughly and return them to the hot pot. Mash them with a potato masher, then add the skimmed milk, Greek yogurt, crushed garlic, remaining salt and pepper, and chopped parsley. Continue mashing until smooth and creamy. Serve the garlic herb mashed potatoes topped with the lean chicken mince and spinach mixture.

title: Lean Turkey Meatballs with Marinara and Zucchini Noodles
ingredients_json: ["500 g Ground turkey, lean", "60 g Whole wheat breadcrumbs", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "50 g Onion, yellow, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped", "0.5 tsp Dried oregano", "2.5 g Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "400 g Canned crushed tomatoes", "1 dl Water", "1 piece Bay leaf", "400 g Zucchini, medium (approx. 2 pieces)"]
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the lean ground turkey, whole wheat breadcrumbs, raw egg, finely chopped yellow onion, minced garlic, chopped fresh parsley, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper. Mix the ingredients thoroughly but gently, being careful not to overmix, until just combined. Form the mixture into approximately 16 to 18 equal-sized meatballs. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Carefully place the meatballs into the hot skillet and brown them on all sides, which should take about 5 to 7 minutes in total. Once browned, remove the meatballs from the skillet and set them aside. In the same skillet, add the canned crushed tomatoes, water, and bay leaf. Bring the tomato sauce to a gentle simmer, then return the browned meatballs to the skillet. Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and let the meatballs simmer in the sauce for 15 to 20 minutes, or until they are cooked through and the sauce has thickened slightly. While the meatballs are simmering, use a spiralizer or a vegetable peeler to create long, thin zucchini noodles from the fresh zucchini. Serve the warm lean turkey meatballs and marinara sauce over the fresh zucchini noodles.

title: Lean Turkey & Spinach Meatballs in Rich Tomato Sauce with Zucchini Noodles
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "60 g Oats, rolled", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced (for meatballs)", "50 g Spinach, fresh, chopped", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "400 g Tomatoes, canned, crushed", "150 ml Water", "10 g Tomato paste", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced (for sauce)", "5 g Basil, fresh, chopped", "5 g Parsley, fresh, chopped", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "400 g Zucchini, fresh"]
instructions: Start by preparing the meatballs. In a large bowl, combine the lean turkey mince, rolled oats, raw egg, finely chopped onion, the first two cloves of minced garlic, and chopped fresh spinach. Season with 1 gram of salt and 0.5 grams of black pepper. Mix everything thoroughly with your hands until well combined but do not overmix. Form the mixture into approximately 18-20 small meatballs, about 30 grams each. Heat 15 ml of extra virgin olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Carefully place the meatballs into the hot pan and brown them on all sides, about 5-7 minutes total. You don't need to cook them through at this stage. Remove the browned meatballs from the pan and set aside. In the same pan, add the remaining two cloves of minced garlic and tomato paste, stirring for about one minute until fragrant. Pour in the crushed canned tomatoes and 150 ml of water, bringing the sauce to a simmer. Add the chopped fresh basil and parsley, and season with the remaining 1 gram of salt and 0.5 grams of black pepper. Return the browned meatballs to the simmering sauce, reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and let it gently cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the meatballs are cooked through and the sauce has slightly thickened. While the meatballs are simmering, prepare the zucchini noodles by spiralling the fresh zucchini. You can gently sauté the zucchini noodles for 2-3 minutes or serve them raw for a refreshing crunch. Serve the Lean Turkey & Spinach Meatballs in Rich Tomato Sauce over the fresh zucchini noodles.

title: Lean Turkey & Spinach Meatballs with Rustic Tomato Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "50 g Breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "1 piece Egg, raw", "15 g Parsley, fresh", "5 ml Olive oil", "400 g Tomatoes, crushed (canned)", "100 ml Water", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "10 ml Olive oil", "100 g Zucchini", "100 g Bell pepper, red"]

title: Creamy Chicken and Vegetable Whole Wheat Noodle Casserole

title: Healthy Chicken & Vegetable Pad Thai with Brown Rice Noodles

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Vegetable Paella
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "400 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, green, raw", "200 g Tomato, ripe, raw", "1 tsp Paprika, smoked", "0.5 tsp Turmeric powder", "0.1 g Saffron threads", "250 g Rice, brown, long grain, uncooked", "800 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "200 g Green beans, raw", "100 g Peas, frozen", "1 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "1 sprig Parsley, fresh"]

title: Healthy Chicken & Vegetable Paella with Saffron
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "400 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "150 g Onion, yellow, raw", "10 g Garlic, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, green, raw", "100 g Green beans, fresh", "400 g Tomatoes, canned, diced, no added salt", "300 g Paella rice, raw", "0.5 g Saffron threads", "800 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "150 g Peas, frozen", "3 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "0.5 piece Lemon, raw", "10 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]

title: Healthy Mediterranean Chicken and Seafood Paella

title: Healthy Chicken and Vegetable Pancit Canton
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, raw, without skin", "200 g Pancit Canton noodles, dry", "15 ml Rapeseed oil", "150 g Onion, yellow, raw, chopped", "15 g Garlic, raw, minced", "5 g Ginger, fresh, raw, grated", "150 g Carrots, raw, julienned", "200 g Cabbage, white, raw, shredded", "100 g Snow peas, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw, sliced", "60 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "100 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "1/2 tsp Black pepper, ground", "100 ml Water", "20 g Green onions, raw, chopped", "1/2 piece Lime, fresh, cut into wedges"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. In a large wok or deep pan, heat the rapeseed oil over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for another minute until fragrant. Add the chicken strips to the wok and cook until they are no longer pink, approximately 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Once the chicken is cooked, add the julienned carrots, shredded cabbage, snow peas, and sliced red bell pepper. Sauté the vegetables for 5-7 minutes until they are tender-crisp. Pour in the low sodium soy sauce and chicken broth, then add the black pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer. Add the dry Pancit Canton noodles directly into the wok along with the additional 100 ml of water. Toss everything together, covering the pan to allow the noodles to cook and absorb the liquid, about 5-8 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. title: Savory Chicken and Vegetable Pancit Bihon
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice vermicelli, dried", "300 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "2 tbsp Canola oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Cabbage, green, raw", "100 g Green beans, raw", "1 piece Bell pepper, red, raw", "60 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "30 ml Calamansi juice", "1 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "5 g Sesame oil, toasted", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]

Heat the canola oil in a large wok or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken strips and stir-fry until lightly browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside. Add the minced onion and garlic to the wok and sauté until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes. Stir in the julienned carrots, sliced green beans, and bell pepper, stir-frying for 3-5 minutes until the vegetables are slightly tender-crisp. Return the cooked chicken to the wok. Pour in the low sodium soy sauce, calamansi juice, and low sodium chicken broth, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer. Add the softened rice vermicelli to the wok, tossing gently to combine all ingredients and absorb the sauce. Continue to cook for another 3-5 minutes, ensuring the noodles are fully cooked and coated with the sauce. Stir in the sliced cabbage and toasted sesame oil, cooking for just 1-2 minutes more until the cabbage is slightly wilted but still retains some crunch. Season with black pepper to taste. title: Healthy Carbonara with Whole Wheat Spaghetti and Peas
ingredients_json: ["250 g Spaghetti, whole wheat", "120 g Pancetta, lean, diced", "3 piece Egg yolk, raw", "1 piece Egg, whole, raw", "60 g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated", "100 g Peas, frozen", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "5 g Black pepper, freshly ground"]
instructions: Begin by bringing a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil for the spaghetti. While the water heats, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced lean pancetta and cook until crispy and golden brown, approximately 8-10 minutes. Remove the pancetta with a slotted spoon, reserving about 1 tablespoon of the rendered fat in the skillet. In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, the whole egg, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, and a generous amount of freshly ground black pepper until well combined and creamy. Cook the whole wheat spaghetti according to package directions until al dente. About 3 minutes before the spaghetti is done, add the frozen peas to the boiling water with the pasta to cook through. Drain the spaghetti and peas, reserving about 1.5 dl of the starchy pasta water. Immediately add the hot spaghetti and peas to the skillet with the reserved pancetta fat, tossing to coat. Off the heat, slowly pour the egg and cheese mixture over the pasta and peas, tossing vigorously with tongs to create a creamy sauce. Add a splash or two of the reserved pasta water as needed to achieve the desired consistency; the starch in the water will help emulsify the sauce. Stir in the crispy pancetta. Serve immediately, garnished with additional black pepper and a sprinkle of Pecorino Romano if desired.

title: Lean Chicken & Spinach Carbonara with Whole Wheat Spaghetti
ingredients_json: ["200 g Spaghetti, whole wheat", "150 g Chicken breast, smoked, lean, diced", "2 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "2 pieces Egg white, raw", "40 g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "2 g Black pepper, freshly ground"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the whole wheat spaghetti and cook according to package directions until al dente. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole eggs, egg whites, grated Pecorino Romano cheese, and freshly ground black pepper until well combined. Before draining the pasta, reserve about 1.5 dl of the starchy pasta water. Drain the spaghetti and immediately add it to the skillet with the chicken and spinach. Remove the skillet from the heat. Add a little of the reserved pasta water, a tablespoon at a time, to create a creamy sauce that coats the spaghetti evenly. Continue tossing until the sauce thickens slightly and emulsifies, being careful not to scramble the eggs. Serve immediately with extra black pepper, if desired.

title: Wholesome Chicken & Spinach Carbonara with Whole Wheat Spaghetti
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat spaghetti", "100 g Lean smoked streaky bacon, diced", "200 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless, cut into small cubes", "2 pieces Egg, whole, large", "1 piece Egg yolk, large", "70 g Parmesan cheese, finely grated", "200 g Fresh spinach, washed", "150 g Brown mushrooms, sliced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "2 g Black pepper, freshly ground"]

While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced lean smoked streaky bacon and cook until crispy, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving about 1 tablespoon of rendered fat in the skillet. Add the cubed chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the sliced brown mushrooms and minced garlic, cooking for another 3-4 minutes until the mushrooms are tender. Add the fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes. In a medium bowl, whisk together the two whole eggs, one egg yolk, and half of the finely grated Parmesan cheese. Season generously with freshly ground black pepper. Reserve about 2 dl of the pasta cooking water before draining the spaghetti. Add the drained spaghetti to the skillet with the chicken, mushrooms, spinach, and garlic. title: Lighter Chicken and Pea Carbonara with Whole Wheat Spaghetti
ingredients_json: ["400 g Whole wheat spaghetti, raw", "400 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "3 pieces Egg, whole, raw", "2 pieces Egg yolk, raw", "60 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "3 cloves Garlic, minced", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Peas, frozen", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt", "1.5 dl Reserved pasta water"]
instructions: Begin by bringing a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Add the whole wheat spaghetti and cook according to package instructions until al dente, usually around 8-10 minutes. In a separate large pan, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is golden brown and cooked through. Add the minced garlic to the pan with the chicken and sauté for another minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn the garlic. Remove the pan from the heat. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole eggs, egg yolks, grated Parmesan cheese, and freshly ground black pepper until well combined. This mixture will form the creamy sauce. title: Whole Wheat Pasta Primavera with Fresh Spring Vegetables and Lemon-Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat spaghetti, dry", "200 g Asparagus, fresh", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "150 g Zucchini, raw", "100 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "100 g Garden peas, frozen", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "6 g Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 dl Vegetable broth, low sodium", "50 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "10 g Fresh basil, chopped", "5 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "3 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the whole wheat spaghetti and cook according to package directions until al dente. While the pasta cooks, prepare your vegetables. Dice the yellow onion, mince the garlic cloves, trim the tough ends off the asparagus and chop them into 2-3 cm pieces, dice the red bell pepper and zucchini into small, uniform pieces, and halve the cherry tomatoes. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until translucent. Stir in the minced garlic, diced bell pepper, and zucchini, cooking for another 5-7 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Add the asparagus and frozen peas to the skillet, continuing to cook for 3-4 minutes until bright green and slightly tender-crisp. Pour in the vegetable broth and fresh lemon juice, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer. Stir in the fresh spinach and halved cherry tomatoes, cooking just until the spinach wilts, about 1-2 minutes. Drain the cooked pasta, reserving about 1 dl of the starchy pasta water. If the sauce appears too dry, add a splash of the reserved pasta water to achieve your desired consistency. Finally, stir in the fresh chopped basil, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Serve immediately, garnished with grated Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Lemon Herb Whole Wheat Pasta Primavera with Spring Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat spaghetti", "200 g Asparagus, raw", "150 g Peas, fresh or frozen", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "200 g Zucchini, raw", "100 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "15 g Garlic, raw", "0.5 piece Lemon, raw", "45 ml Olive oil", "30 g Parmesan cheese, hard, grated", "100 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "15 g Fresh basil, raw", "4 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the whole wheat spaghetti and cook according to package directions until al dente. Add the asparagus pieces and fresh or frozen peas, cooking for another 3-4 minutes until vibrant and crisp-tender. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and spinach, cooking just until the spinach wilts, about 1-2 minutes. Pour in the vegetable broth and the juice of half a lemon, bringing it to a gentle simmer. Add the drained pasta to the skillet with the vegetables. Toss everything together, adding a splash of the reserved pasta water if needed to create a light sauce and ensure the pasta is well coated. Stir in the fresh basil, grated Parmesan cheese, lemon zest, salt, and black pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Garden Vegetable Whole Wheat Pasta Primavera
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat penne pasta", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh, crushed", "150 g Onion, yellow, medium, chopped", "150 g Broccoli florets", "100 g Asparagus spears, trimmed, cut into 3cm pieces", "200 g Zucchini, medium, diced", "150 g Bell pepper, red, medium, diced", "150 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "1 dl Vegetable broth, low sodium", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 pc Lemon, zest and juice", "2 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tbsp Basil, fresh, chopped", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.25 tsp Salt, table"]
instructions: Cook the whole wheat pasta according to package directions until al dente. Before draining, reserve 1 dl of the pasta water. Drain the pasta and set aside. Add the broccoli florets, asparagus, diced zucchini, and red bell pepper to the pan. Sauté for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a gentle simmer. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and fresh spinach, cooking for 2-3 minutes until the spinach wilts. Stir in the drained pasta, lemon zest, lemon juice, chopped fresh parsley, fresh basil, black pepper, and salt. Gradually add the reserved pasta water, a little at a time, until the sauce reaches your desired consistency, coating the pasta and vegetables well. Finally, stir in the grated Parmesan cheese just before serving.

title: Mediterranean Chicken & Whole Wheat Pasta Salad with Lemon-Herb Dressing
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat fusilli pasta, dry", "400 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "250 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "200 g Cucumber, raw", "100 g Red onion, raw", "150 g Green bell pepper, raw", "80 g Kalamata olives, pitted", "100 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "40 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "30 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "2 g Dried oregano", "5 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: First, cook the whole wheat fusilli pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain the pasta, rinse it with cold water to stop the cooking process and cool it down, then set aside. While the pasta cooks, prepare the chicken: season the chicken breast fillets with a pinch of salt and pepper, then grill or pan-fry them over medium-high heat until fully cooked through and golden brown, about 6-8 minutes per side depending on thickness. Remove from heat, let rest for a few minutes, then dice into bite-sized pieces. Next, wash and chop all the vegetables: halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber, finely slice the red onion, and chop the green bell pepper into small pieces. In a large bowl, combine the cooled pasta, diced chicken, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, green bell pepper, and pitted Kalamata olives. Crumble the reduced-fat feta cheese over the mixture. title: Mediterranean Chicken & Whole Wheat Pasta Salad

Prepare the vegetables by halving the cherry tomatoes, dicing the cucumber, thinly slicing the red onion, and dicing the red bell pepper. Mince the garlic cloves finely. In the bowl with the cooled pasta, combine the diced chicken, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, red bell pepper, and Kalamata olives. Add the fresh spinach to the mixture. For the dressing, whisk together the extra virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, red wine vinegar, minced garlic, dried oregano, salt, and ground black pepper in a small separate bowl until well combined. title: Mediterranean Chicken and Whole Wheat Pasta Salad
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat penne pasta, dry", "300 g Chicken breast, skinless", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "200 g Cherry tomatoes", "150 g Cucumber", "100 g Bell pepper, yellow", "50 g Red onion", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Feta cheese, light", "4 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt"]

Wash and chop the cherry tomatoes in half, dice the cucumber and yellow bell pepper, and thinly slice the red onion. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooled pasta, diced chicken, halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, diced bell pepper, sliced red onion, and fresh spinach. For the dressing, whisk together 4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, dried oregano, garlic powder, ground black pepper, and salt in a small bowl until well combined. Crumble the light feta cheese over the top if using, and serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes for flavors to meld.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Chicken Pasta Salad with Lemon Herb Vinaigrette
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat fusilli pasta, uncooked", "300 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "200 g Cherry tomatoes, fresh", "150 g Cucumber, fresh", "100 g Red bell pepper, fresh", "50 g Red onion, fresh", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.25 tsp Salt, table"]
instructions: First, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the whole wheat fusilli pasta according to package directions until al dente. Remove from heat, let it rest for a few minutes, then dice the chicken into bite-sized pieces. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooled pasta, diced chicken, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red bell pepper, red onion, and fresh spinach. Pour the dressing over the pasta salad mixture and toss gently to combine all ingredients. Finally, crumble the reduced-fat feta cheese over the top and gently fold it in. Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator for flavors to meld.

title: Lean Chicken and Root Vegetable Wholewheat Pasties
ingredients_json: ["300 g Wholewheat flour", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "100 ml Cold water", "1 g Salt, table", "300 g Chicken breast, raw, without skin", "200 g Potato, raw, without skin", "150 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "50 g Green peas, frozen", "100 ml Chicken stock, low sodium", "15 ml Olive oil", "1 piece Egg, raw", "5 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Thyme, dried"]
instructions: First, prepare the pastry. In a large bowl, rub the butter into the wholewheat flour and salt until it resembles breadcrumbs. Gradually add the cold water, mixing until a dough forms. Knead lightly for a minute, then wrap in cling film and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. Next, prepare the filling. Dice the chicken breast, potato, carrot, and onion into small, even pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened. Add the chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned. Stir in the diced potato and carrot, then pour in the chicken stock. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender. Stir in the frozen green peas, fresh parsley, dried thyme, and black pepper, and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and let the filling cool slightly. Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Divide the chilled pastry into 4 equal portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each portion into a circle about 20 cm in diameter. Spoon a quarter of the cooled filling onto one half of each pastry circle, leaving a small border around the edge. Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling to create a semi-circle. Crimp the edges firmly to seal, using a fork if desired. Place the pasties onto the prepared baking sheet. In a small bowl, whisk the egg. Brush the tops of the pasties with the egg wash for a golden finish. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and cooked through. Serve hot.

title: Healthy Chicken and Root Vegetable Pasties with Wholemeal Pastry
ingredients_json: ["300 g Wholemeal flour", "80 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "100 ml Cold water", "1 piece Egg, raw (for egg wash)", "2 g Salt", "300 g Chicken breast, raw, boneless, skinless", "180 g Potato, raw, peeled", "150 g Carrot, raw, peeled", "100 g Swede (rutabaga), raw, peeled", "80 g Onion, raw", "50 g Green peas, frozen", "5 g Fresh thyme, chopped", "5 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "100 ml Chicken stock, low sodium"]
instructions: First, prepare the pastry. In a large bowl, rub the cold butter into the wholemeal flour and 2g of salt until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Dice the chicken breast, potato, carrot, swede, and onion into small, even pieces. In a large pan, combine the diced onion, chicken, potato, carrot, and swede with 100ml chicken stock over medium heat. Cook for about 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is lightly cooked through and the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the frozen peas, fresh thyme, fresh parsley, 3g of salt, and black pepper. Cook for another 3-5 minutes, then remove from heat and let the filling cool completely. Preheat your oven to 190°C (fan 170°C). Divide the chilled pastry into 4 equal portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each portion into a circle approximately 20 cm in diameter. Spoon a quarter of the cooled filling onto one half of each pastry circle, leaving a small border. Lightly brush the edges with a little water or the beaten egg. Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, then firmly crimp the edges to seal, either by hand or with a fork. Place the pasties on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Brush the tops with the remaining beaten egg for a golden finish. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is piping hot. Let them cool slightly before serving.

title: Healthy Chicken and Root Vegetable Pasties with Wholemeal Crust
ingredients_json: ["250 g Wholemeal flour, unspecified", "60 ml Olive oil", "100 ml Water, tap", "3 g Salt, table", "300 g Chicken breast, raw, without skin", "200 g Potato, raw, peeled", "150 g Carrot, raw, peeled", "100 g Peas, green, frozen", "100 g Onion, raw", "100 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "5 g Fresh thyme, leaves", "5 g Fresh rosemary, leaves", "1 piece Egg, raw"]
instructions: To prepare the wholemeal pastry, combine the wholemeal flour and 2 grams of salt in a large bowl. Gradually add the olive oil and then the water, mixing until a dough forms. Sauté the onion for 3-5 minutes until softened, then add the diced chicken, potato, and carrot. Cook for about 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is browned and vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the peas, chicken broth, fresh thyme, rosemary, and the remaining 1 gram of salt. Simmer for 5-7 minutes until the liquid has reduced slightly and the vegetables are tender. Remove from heat and let the filling cool completely. Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). Divide the chilled pastry into 4 equal portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each portion into a circle approximately 20 cm (8 inches) in diameter. Spoon a quarter of the cooled filling onto one half of each pastry circle, leaving a small border. Lightly brush the edges of the pastry with water, then fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, creating a semicircle. Crimp the edges firmly to seal the pasties, either with a fork or by folding and pressing the pastry edge. Place the pasties on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Whisk the egg in a small bowl and brush the top of each pasty with the egg wash for a golden finish. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and puffed. Serve hot.

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Spinach Ricotta Pierogies with Caramelized Onions and Dill Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat flour", "100 ml Water, warm", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 g Salt", "250 g Ricotta cheese, low fat", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "0.5 piece Onion, yellow, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 g Fresh dill", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "1 piece Onion, yellow, medium", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat"]
instructions: To prepare the dough, combine the whole wheat flour, warm water, one raw egg, 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and 2g of salt in a large bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms, then knead on a lightly floured surface for about 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the dough with a clean cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes at room temperature. While the dough rests, prepare the filling. Finely chop the half onion and mince the garlic cloves. Sauté them gently in a small amount of olive oil until softened, about 3 minutes. Add the fresh spinach and cook until wilted, squeezing out any excess water. In a medium bowl, combine the low-fat ricotta cheese, cooked spinach mixture, finely chopped fresh dill, and 0.5g of black pepper. Mix well to combine. Divide the rested dough into two equal portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll out one portion of dough to about 2-3 mm thickness. Using a round cookie cutter or glass (about 7-8 cm diameter), cut out circles. Place about a teaspoon of the filling in the center of each circle. Fold the dough over to create a half-moon shape and crimp the edges with a fork to seal, ensuring no filling leaks out. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully drop the pierogies into the boiling water in batches, making sure not to overcrowd the pot. Cook for 3-4 minutes after they float to the surface, until cooked through. While the pierogies boil, slice the remaining whole onion thinly.
