Stir in the fresh lime juice and chopped coriander leaves. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Serve warm as a main dish or a hearty side.

title: Maple-Glazed Oven-Baked Pork Ribs with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["1 kg Pork loin ribs, trimmed", "15 ml Olive oil", "5 g Smoked paprika", "5 g Garlic powder", "5 g Onion powder", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt", "100 g Tomato paste, unsalted", "50 ml Apple cider vinegar", "30 ml Maple syrup", "10 ml Worcestershire sauce", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g Cayenne pepper, ground", "500 g Sweet potato, raw, unpeeled", "300 g Broccoli, florets", "150 g Red onion, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C. In a small bowl, combine smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, 2 g black pepper, and 5 g salt to create your rib rub. Pat the pork loin ribs dry thoroughly with paper towels. Rub the spice mixture evenly over both sides of the ribs. Place the seasoned ribs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, bone-side down. Cover the baking sheet tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 2.5 to 3 hours, or until the ribs are very tender and easily pull away from the bone. While the ribs are baking, prepare the maple glaze. In a small saucepan, combine the tomato paste, apple cider vinegar, maple syrup, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, and 2 g cayenne pepper. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, and let it cook for 10-15 minutes until it has thickened slightly. Taste the glaze and adjust seasonings if necessary. Once the ribs are tender, remove them from the oven and carefully discard the aluminum foil. Increase the oven temperature to 200°C. Drain any excess liquid from the baking sheet. Brush a generous amount of the prepared maple glaze evenly over the top side of the ribs. Return the ribs to the oven, uncovered, and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, brushing with more glaze every 5-7 minutes, until the glaze is beautifully caramelized and sticky. While the ribs are caramelizing, prepare your roasted vegetables. Wash and dice the sweet potato into 2 cm cubes. Cut the broccoli into florets. Peel and slice the red onion into thick wedges. In a large bowl, toss the sweet potato, broccoli, and red onion with the remaining 15 ml olive oil, 3 g salt, and 2 g black pepper. Spread the seasoned vegetables in a single layer on a separate baking sheet. Roast the vegetables in the 200°C oven alongside the ribs during their final glazing stage, or immediately after removing the ribs if space is limited. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are fork-tender and lightly browned, and the broccoli is slightly charred. Once the ribs are done, let them rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing them into individual portions. Serve the glazed ribs immediately with the roasted sweet potatoes and broccoli.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Brown Rice Casserole
ingredients_json: ["200 g Brown rice, uncooked", "400 g Chicken breast, skinless and boneless", "150 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "150 g Red bell pepper, chopped", "150 g Zucchini, chopped", "10 g Garlic, minced", "400 g Canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "500 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "150 g Fresh spinach", "30 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 g Dried oregano", "1 g Dried basil", "3 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "50 g Feta cheese, crumbled"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius. Start by dicing the chicken breast into 2-3 cm pieces, chopping the onion, red bell pepper, and zucchini into similar-sized pieces, and mincing the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and cook for about 3-4 minutes until lightly browned on all sides, then remove it from the pot and set aside. Reduce the heat to medium, then add the chopped onion, red bell pepper, and zucchini to the pot. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the minced garlic, dried oregano, and dried basil, cooking for another minute until fragrant. Return the browned chicken to the pot. Add the uncooked brown rice, canned chopped tomatoes, low-sodium vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper. Stir everything well to combine. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then remove the pot from the heat. Stir in the fresh spinach, allowing it to wilt slightly from the residual heat. Cover the pot tightly with a lid or aluminum foil and transfer it to the preheated oven. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the brown rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese over the casserole during the last 5 minutes of baking. Let the casserole rest, covered, for 5-10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld and the rice to fully absorb any remaining liquid.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken and Brown Rice Casserole with Spinach
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Onion, yellow, diced", "100 g Carrots, peeled and diced", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "150 g Bell pepper, red, diced", "250 g Brown rice, uncooked", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "700 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "400 g Chicken breast, raw, diced", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). In a large oven-safe pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion and carrots, and sauté for 5-7 minutes until they begin to soften. Stir in the minced garlic and diced red bell pepper, cooking for another 3 minutes until fragrant. Add the uncooked brown rice, dried oregano, and dried thyme to the pot, toasting for 1 minute while stirring. Pour in the low-sodium chicken broth and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Incorporate the diced chicken breast, salt, and black pepper, stirring everything well to combine. Once simmering again, cover the pot tightly with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven. Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until most of the liquid has been absorbed and the brown rice is tender. Carefully remove the pot from the oven. Stir in the fresh spinach, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Cover the pot again and let it stand for 5-10 minutes, allowing the spinach to wilt and the flavors to meld. If desired, stir in the grated Parmesan cheese just before serving.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Brown Rice Casserole
ingredients_json: ["150 g Brown rice, uncooked", "400 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "150 g Bell pepper, red, chopped", "150 g Zucchini, raw, sliced", "100 g Spinach, raw", "500 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "100 g Tomato paste", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "50 g Feta cheese, light, crumbled", "2 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Dice the chicken breast into 2 cm cubes. Chop the onion and bell pepper into similar-sized pieces, and slice the zucchini into half-moons. Mince the garlic. In a large, oven-safe casserole dish, heat the olive oil over medium heat on the stovetop. Add the diced chicken and cook for 5-7 minutes, until lightly browned on all sides. Remove the chicken and set aside. Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and zucchini to the same dish and sauté for 8-10 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, cooking for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Pour in the low-sodium beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, and Dijon mustard. Bring the mixture to a simmer. In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and water until smooth to create a slurry. Slowly pour the cornstarch slurry into the simmering gravy while stirring constantly until the gravy thickens to your desired consistency. Season the gravy with the remaining 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper, or to taste. Return the Salisbury steak patties to the skillet with the gravy, spooning some gravy over them. Let them simmer in the gravy for 2-3 minutes to absorb the flavors.

While the steaks are simmering, prepare the cauliflower mash. Steam or boil the cauliflower florets until very tender, about 10-15 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Transfer the cooked cauliflower to a food processor or a large bowl. Add the skim milk and butter, then mash or process until smooth and creamy. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.

To serve, place a portion of creamy cauliflower mash on each plate, top with a Salisbury steak, and generously spoon over the mushroom gravy. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley.

title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon-Herb Quinoa and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["300 g Salmon fillet, skin-on", "100 g Quinoa, uncooked", "300 g Asparagus spears, fresh", "30 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 piece Lemon, fresh", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Begin by preparing the quinoa: rinse it thoroughly under cold water, then combine it with 200 ml of water and a pinch of salt in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until all water is absorbed. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. While the quinoa cooks, preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). Trim the woody ends off the asparagus spears. Toss the asparagus with 10 ml of olive oil, a pinch of salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until tender-crisp. Mince the garlic cloves. Pat the salmon fillets dry with a paper towel and season generously with salt and pepper. Heat the remaining 20 ml of olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Once the oil is shimmering, carefully place the salmon fillets skin-side down (if applicable) in the hot pan. Cook for 4-6 minutes, or until the skin is crispy and golden. Flip the salmon and add the minced garlic to the pan, cooking for another 3-5 minutes, depending on the thickness of the fillet, until cooked to your desired doneness. Squeeze the juice from half of the lemon over the salmon during the last minute of cooking. To serve, divide the fluffy quinoa between two plates. Top with the roasted asparagus and pan-seared salmon. Garnish with freshly chopped parsley and a lemon wedge from the remaining half.

title: Lemon Herb Baked Salmon with Roasted Asparagus and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["300 g Salmon fillet, skin on", "100 g Quinoa, uncooked", "300 g Asparagus, fresh", "30 ml Olive oil", "1 piece Lemon, fresh", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Pepper, black, ground", "5 g Dill, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Rinse the quinoa thoroughly under cold water, then combine it with 200 ml of water in a small pot. Pat the salmon fillet dry with paper towels. Wash and trim the woody ends from the asparagus. In a small bowl, mince the garlic cloves and mix with 15 ml of olive oil, the juice of half a lemon, 1.5 g of salt, and 0.5 g of black pepper. Brush this mixture over the salmon fillet and asparagus. Arrange the salmon and asparagus on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily, and the asparagus is tender-crisp. While baking, finely chop the fresh dill. Once cooked, flake the salmon into desired portions. Serve the baked salmon and roasted asparagus alongside the fluffy quinoa. Drizzle with the remaining 15 ml of olive oil and the juice of the other half lemon. Garnish with fresh dill and the remaining 1.5 g of salt and 0.5 g of black pepper.

title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon-Dill Quinoa and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["300 g Salmon fillet, skin-on", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 piece Lemon, fresh, medium", "120 g Quinoa, uncooked", "250 ml Water, tap", "1 clove Garlic, fresh", "2 tbsp Dill, fresh, chopped", "300 g Asparagus, fresh", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]

While the quinoa cooks, prepare the asparagus. Trim the woody ends off the asparagus spears. Toss them with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, a pinch of salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until tender-crisp. Pat the salmon fillets dry with a paper towel. Season both sides with salt and black pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, place the salmon fillets skin-side down in the skillet. Cook for 4-5 minutes until the skin is crispy and golden. Flip the salmon and cook for another 3-4 minutes, or until cooked through to your desired doneness. Squeeze half of the lemon over the cooked salmon. Serve the pan-seared salmon immediately alongside the lemon-dill quinoa and roasted asparagus. Garnish with a lemon wedge.

title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon-Dill Quinoa and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["300 g Salmon fillet, skin-on", "120 g Quinoa, uncooked", "250 g Asparagus, fresh", "30 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 piece Lemon, medium", "15 g Dill, fresh, chopped", "10 g Garlic, cloves, minced", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "250 ml Water, tap"]

Trim the woody ends off the asparagus spears. Toss the asparagus with 10 ml of olive oil, a pinch of salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet. While the salmon bakes, prepare the lemon-dill mixture. In a small bowl, combine the minced garlic, the juice of the lemon, the lemon zest, and the fresh chopped dill. title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon-Dill Potatoes and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["360 g Salmon fillet, skin on", "400 g Potato, raw, unpeeled", "300 g Asparagus, raw", "28 g Olive oil", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "15 g Dill, fresh", "6 g Garlic, raw", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). Wash and scrub the potatoes, then cut them into roughly 2 cm chunks. Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus. On a baking tray, toss the potato chunks and asparagus with 14 g (1 tbsp) of olive oil, 2 g of salt, and 1 g of black pepper. Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and lightly browned, and the asparagus is crisp-tender. While the vegetables are roasting, prepare the salmon. Pat the salmon fillets dry with a paper towel and season both sides with the remaining 3 g of salt and 1 g of black pepper. Finely chop the fresh dill and mince the garlic. Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat with the remaining 14 g (1 tbsp) of olive oil. Once hot, place the salmon fillets skin-side down in the pan. Cook for 4-5 minutes until the skin is crispy. Flip the salmon and cook for another 3-4 minutes, or until cooked through to your liking. In the last minute of cooking, add the minced garlic and chopped dill to the pan, along with the juice of half the lemon. Stir gently to coat the salmon. Serve the pan-seared salmon immediately alongside the roasted potatoes and asparagus, with the remaining half lemon cut into wedges for squeezing over the dish.

title: Grilled Chicken and Hummus Whole Wheat Pita Sandwiches
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Pita bread, whole wheat", "200 g Chicken breast, grilled, unseasoned", "80 g Hummus, store-bought", "60 g Cucumber, fresh, sliced", "80 g Tomato, fresh, sliced", "30 g Lettuce, romaine, shredded", "10 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "5 g Lemon juice, fresh", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Begin by slicing the grilled chicken breast into thin, even strips. Gently warm the whole wheat pita breads in a dry pan over medium heat for about 30 seconds per side, or microwave briefly until soft and pliable. Carefully cut each pita bread in half along the edge to create a pocket. Inside each pita pocket, spread 40g of hummus generously, ensuring it coats the interior. Evenly layer the sliced grilled chicken, fresh cucumber, tomato, and shredded romaine lettuce into the two pita halves. Drizzle a small amount of fresh lemon juice over the filling in each sandwich, then season with black pepper and a tiny pinch of salt. Serve these wholesome sandwiches immediately for a satisfying and healthy dinner.

title: Grilled Chicken and Avocado Sandwich with Whole Wheat Bread
ingredients_json: ["4 slices Bread, whole wheat, medium", "200 g Chicken breast fillet, raw, skinless", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "0.5 piece Avocado, medium", "50 g Lettuce, Romaine", "100 g Tomato, raw", "20 g Red onion, raw", "30 ml Mayonnaise, light", "5 ml Dijon mustard", "1 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: First, pat the chicken breast dry with paper towels and season with half of the salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Carefully place the seasoned chicken breast in the hot pan and cook for 5 to 7 minutes per side, or until it is thoroughly cooked through and a nice golden-brown crust has formed. Once cooked, remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest on a cutting board for a few minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain. While the chicken is cooking, prepare the vegetables by thinly slicing the tomato and red onion, and washing and drying the Romaine lettuce leaves. In a small bowl, whisk together the light mayonnaise and Dijon mustard until well combined. If desired, lightly toast the whole wheat bread slices. To assemble each sandwich, spread a generous amount of the mayonnaise-mustard mixture evenly on one side of two bread slices. Layer with crisp lettuce, then add a portion of the thinly sliced grilled chicken, followed by tomato slices, red onion rings, and finally, thin slices of avocado. Season with the remaining salt and pepper to taste. Place the remaining bread slices on top to complete the two hearty sandwiches.

title: Grilled Chicken & Avocado Power Sandwich
ingredients_json: ["120 g Bread, wholemeal, wheat", "200 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "100 g Avocado, raw", "50 g Lettuce, raw", "120 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Cucumber, raw", "80 g Bell pepper, yellow, raw", "30 g Yogurt, Greek, fat free", "10 g Mustard, Dijon", "5 ml Lemon juice, raw", "1 g Oregano, dried", "1.5 g Salt, table", "1 g Pepper, black"]
instructions: Begin by cooking the chicken fillet. You can grill it, pan-fry it, or bake it until it is fully cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 74°C. Once cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly. Slice the tomato, cucumber, and bell pepper into even, thin pieces. Wash and pat dry the lettuce leaves. Carefully halve the avocado, remove the pit, scoop out the flesh, and slice or lightly mash it. Lay out the wholemeal bread slices. Evenly spread the prepared yogurt dressing on one side of each bread slice. On two of the bread slices, layer the fresh lettuce, followed by the sliced chicken, tomato, cucumber, bell pepper, and finally the avocado. Top with the remaining two bread slices, dressing-side down, to form two complete sandwiches. For easier eating, cut each sandwich in half diagonally before serving.

title: Mediterranean Turkey and Hummus Sandwich on Whole Wheat
ingredients_json: ["2 slices Bread, whole wheat", "100 g Turkey breast, cooked, sliced", "50 g Hummus, classic", "30 g Spinach, fresh", "80 g Tomato, red, raw", "50 g Cucumber, raw", "20 g Onion, red, raw", "30 g Avocado, raw", "10 g Mustard, Dijon", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Begin by toasting the whole wheat bread slices to your desired crispness. While the bread is toasting, thinly slice the red onion, tomato, and cucumber. Once the bread is toasted, spread the Dijon mustard evenly on one slice and the hummus generously on the other. Layer the fresh spinach on top of the hummus. Arrange the turkey breast slices over the spinach, followed by the sliced tomato, cucumber, and red onion. Add the avocado slices on top of the vegetables. Season with a sprinkle of black pepper. Finally, place the mustard-coated bread slice on top, gently press down, and serve immediately.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Sausage with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken sausage, pre-cooked, lean", "500 g Sweet potato, raw, peeled, diced", "400 g Broccoli florets, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw, diced", "150 g Onion, yellow, raw, cut into wedges", "30 ml Olive oil", "5 g Garlic powder", "3 g Dried oregano", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper for easier cleanup. Begin by slicing the lean pre-cooked chicken sausage into 2 cm thick rounds. Peel and dice the sweet potato into 2.5 cm cubes. Separate the broccoli into florets and chop the red bell pepper into similar-sized pieces. Slice the yellow onion into wedges. In a large mixing bowl, combine the diced sweet potato, broccoli florets, bell pepper, and onion wedges. Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables, then sprinkle evenly with garlic powder, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper. Toss everything thoroughly to ensure all the vegetables are well coated with the oil and seasonings. Spread the seasoned vegetables in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Distribute the sliced chicken sausage evenly among the vegetables on the sheet. Roast the mixture in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. After this time, carefully remove the baking sheet from the oven and use a spatula to flip the vegetables and sausage to promote even browning. Return the baking sheet to the oven and continue roasting for another 15 to 20 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork, the broccoli has slightly charred edges, and the sausage is heated through and lightly browned. Serve this healthy and flavorful sheet pan dinner immediately.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Sausage with Roasted Peppers and Sweet Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken sausage, lean, raw", "500 g Sweet potato, raw, peeled, diced", "200 g Bell pepper, red, raw, sliced", "200 g Bell pepper, yellow, raw, sliced", "150 g Onion, yellow, raw, sliced", "30 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "5 g Paprika powder", "2 g Garlic powder", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Salt, table", "10 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper to prevent sticking. In a spacious mixing bowl, combine the diced sweet potato, sliced red and yellow bell peppers, and sliced yellow onion. Drizzle the vegetables with olive oil, then sprinkle evenly with paprika powder, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt. Toss all the ingredients thoroughly to ensure the vegetables are well coated with the oil and seasonings. Arrange the seasoned vegetables in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Place the chicken sausages among the vegetables, ensuring they have good contact with the pan for browning. Roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, making sure to toss the vegetables halfway through the cooking time. Continue roasting until the sweet potatoes are tender, and the sausages are nicely browned and cooked through. Once removed from the oven, garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving hot.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Sausage with Roasted Mediterranean Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken sausage, lean", "300 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "200 g Bell pepper, red, fresh", "150 g Zucchini, fresh", "200 g Sweet potato, fresh", "100 g Onion, red, fresh", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]

Mince the fresh garlic cloves finely. In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced chicken sausage, all the chopped vegetables, minced garlic, olive oil, dried oregano, and black pepper. Toss everything well to ensure the ingredients are evenly coated. Spread the mixture in a single layer on a large baking sheet, making sure not to overcrowd the pan for optimal roasting. Roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender-crisp and lightly caramelized, and the sausage is heated through and slightly browned. Stir the ingredients halfway through the cooking time to promote even roasting. Serve this wholesome sheet pan meal hot.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Sausage with Roasted Mediterranean Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken sausage, pre-cooked", "300 g Sweet potato, raw, with skin", "200 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "150 g Zucchini, raw", "100 g Red onion, raw", "200 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "30 g Olive oil", "5 g Garlic clove, raw", "2 g Dried oregano", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper"]

In a large bowl, combine the chopped sweet potato, bell pepper, zucchini, red onion, cherry tomatoes, sliced chicken sausage, olive oil, minced garlic, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper. Toss everything together until the vegetables and sausage are evenly coated. Spread the mixture in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized, and the sausage is lightly browned.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Sausage with Roasted Root Vegetables and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken sausage, raw", "500 g Sweet potato, raw, with skin", "200 g Carrot, raw", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "150 g Red onion, raw", "30 ml Olive oil", "5 g Rosemary, fresh", "5 g Thyme, fresh", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Pepper, black"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut the chicken sausages into 1-inch thick rounds. Dice the sweet potatoes and carrots into 1-inch pieces. Chop the broccoli into florets and slice the red onion into wedges. In a large bowl, combine the chopped vegetables and sausage. Drizzle with olive oil, then add the fresh rosemary, thyme, salt, and black pepper. Toss everything together until well coated. Spread the mixture in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Roast for 25-30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized, and the sausage is cooked through and lightly browned, flipping halfway through to ensure even cooking. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Seitan Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["250 g Seitan", "200 g Broccoli, florets", "1 piece Red bell pepper", "1 piece Yellow bell pepper", "100 g Carrot", "3 clove Garlic", "2 cm Ginger root", "3 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tsp Sesame oil, toasted", "1 tbsp Cornstarch", "120 ml Water", "1 tsp Sriracha sauce", "2 tbsp Rapeseed oil", "200 g Brown rice, uncooked"]
instructions: Begin by cooking the brown rice according to package instructions; typically, combine 200 g of brown rice with 400 ml of water in a pot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30-40 minutes until water is absorbed. Deseed and slice the red and yellow bell peppers into thin strips. Peel and thinly slice or julienne the carrot. Mince the garlic cloves and grate the ginger root. In a small bowl, whisk together the low sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, cornstarch, water, and sriracha sauce until smooth to create your stir-fry sauce. Heat 1 tablespoon of rapeseed oil in a large wok or a deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the seitan and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until lightly browned and slightly crispy, then remove from the pan and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of rapeseed oil to the hot pan. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the broccoli florets, bell pepper strips, and carrot slices to the pan. Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Return the cooked seitan to the pan with the vegetables. Give the prepared stir-fry sauce a quick whisk again to ensure the cornstarch is fully incorporated, then pour it over the seitan and vegetables. Stir continuously for 1-2 minutes as the sauce thickens and coats all the ingredients. Remove from heat and serve immediately over the cooked brown rice.

title: Seitan and Broccoli Stir-fry with Ginger-Garlic Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g Seitan, plain", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "200 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Onion, yellow, raw", "15 g Garlic, raw", "10 g Ginger, fresh", "30 ml Rapeseed oil", "60 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "30 ml Rice vinegar", "15 ml Sesame oil, toasted", "10 g Cornstarch", "200 g Brown rice, uncooked"]

In a small bowl, whisk together the low-sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, and cornstarch; set aside. Heat 15 ml of rapeseed oil in a large wok or a deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the seitan and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until lightly browned and slightly crispy. Remove the seitan from the pan and set aside. Add the remaining 15 ml of rapeseed oil to the pan. Add the diced onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Add the broccoli, bell pepper, and carrot to the pan. Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Return the seitan to the pan with the vegetables. Give the prepared sauce a quick whisk again to ensure the cornstarch is dissolved, then pour it over the seitan and vegetables. Stir continuously for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats everything evenly. Remove from heat. Serve the Seitan and Broccoli Stir-fry hot over the cooked brown rice.

title: Ginger Garlic Seitan Stir-fry with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g Seitan, plain", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Broccoli, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "50 g Onion, yellow, raw", "20 g Ginger, fresh", "10 g Garlic, raw", "60 ml Soy sauce, light", "30 ml Rice vinegar", "15 ml Maple syrup", "10 ml Sesame oil", "5 g Corn starch", "1 dl Water", "200 g Brown rice, uncooked"]

Add the broccoli florets and bell pepper strips and continue to stir-fry for another 4-5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp. Return the seitan to the wok. Give the prepared sauce a quick whisk again and pour it over the seitan and vegetables. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats everything evenly. Serve the ginger garlic seitan stir-fry immediately over the cooked brown rice.

title: Hearty Seitan and Vegetable Stir-fry with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g Seitan, plain", "500 g Broccoli, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, yellow, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "20 g Garlic, raw", "10 g Ginger, raw", "30 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "20 ml Rice vinegar", "5 ml Sesame oil, toasted", "10 g Cornstarch", "100 ml Water", "30 ml Olive oil", "200 g Brown rice, uncooked"]
instructions: First, prepare the brown rice according to package directions; typically, combine 200 grams of brown rice with 400 ml of water in a pot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 40-45 minutes until the water is absorbed and rice is tender. Chop the broccoli into florets, slice the bell peppers into thin strips, julienne the carrot, dice the onion, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger. In a small bowl, whisk together the low-sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, cornstarch, and 100 ml of water to create the stir-fry sauce. Heat 15 ml of olive oil in a large wok or a deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the seitan strips and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until lightly browned. Remove the seitan from the pan and set aside. Add the remaining 15 ml of olive oil to the pan. Add the onion, carrot, and broccoli florets, stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until the vegetables start to become tender-crisp. Add the bell peppers, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the pan, and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Return the seitan to the pan. Give the prepared stir-fry sauce a quick whisk again, then pour it over the seitan and vegetables. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce thickens and coats all the ingredients. Serve the hot seitan and vegetable stir-fry immediately over the cooked brown rice.

title: Lemon Herb Seitan with Roasted Root Vegetables and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["400 g Seitan, plain", "300 g Carrots, raw", "200 g Parsnips, raw", "400 g Sweet potato, raw", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "30 ml Olive oil", "4 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "5 g Rosemary, fresh", "5 g Thyme, fresh", "200 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "30 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "200 g Quinoa, uncooked", "400 ml Water", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Pepper, black, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Wash and peel the carrots, parsnips, and sweet potato, then chop them into bite-sized pieces. In a large bowl, toss the chopped root vegetables with 15 ml of olive oil, 2.5 g of salt, 1 g of black pepper, 2 minced garlic cloves, and half of the fresh rosemary and thyme leaves. Spread the seasoned vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized, flipping halfway through. While the vegetables are roasting, rinse the quinoa thoroughly under cold water. Combine the rinsed quinoa with 400 ml of water and 2.5 g of salt in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until all the water is absorbed and the quinoa is fluffy. Let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork. Slice the seitan into thin strips or bite-sized pieces. In a large pan, heat the remaining 15 ml of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the seitan and sauté for 5-7 minutes until lightly browned. Mince the remaining 2 garlic cloves and add them to the pan with the seitan, cooking for another minute until fragrant. Zest the lemon directly into the pan, then squeeze in the juice from the entire lemon. Pour in the vegetable broth and soy sauce, along with the remaining fresh rosemary and thyme. title: Lean Lamb & Sweet Potato Shepherd's Pie with Garden Vegetables

title: Lean Lamb and Root Vegetable Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Topping

ingredients_json: ["500 g Lamb mince, lean", "15 ml Olive oil", "150 g Onion, raw", "200 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Celery, raw", "10 g Garlic, raw", "30 g Tomato paste", "2 g Dried thyme", "2 g Dried rosemary", "400 g Canned chopped tomatoes, no added salt", "250 ml Stock, beef, low salt", "150 g Green peas, frozen", "150 g Sweet corn, frozen", "500 g Cauliflower, raw", "300 g Sweet potato, raw", "100 ml Skimmed milk", "14 g Butter, unsalted", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "4 g Salt"]

title: Healthy Lemon-Garlic Shrimp with Creamy Polenta and Sautéed Greens
ingredients_json: ["150 g Polenta, whole grain, dry", "600 ml Water", "120 ml Milk, skimmed", "20 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "5 g Butter, unsalted", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "300 g Shrimp, raw, peeled, defrosted", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "50 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "5 g Garlic, raw, minced", "70 g Bell pepper, red, chopped", "50 g Spinach, raw", "20 g Bacon, smoked, lean, diced", "120 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "1 g Paprika, ground", "0.5 g Red pepper flakes", "5 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]

title: Mediterranean Turkey Sliders with Creamy Avocado Tzatziki

title: Healthy Chicken and Black Bean Tamales with Poblano
ingredients_json: ["250 g Masa harina", "250 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "60 g Coconut oil, refined", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt", "18 pieces Corn husks", "300 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "200 g Black beans, canned, drained, rinsed", "1 piece Poblano pepper", "100 g Onion, yellow", "15 g Garlic, raw", "30 g Tomato paste", "5 g Cumin, ground", "5 g Paprika, smoked", "2 g Chipotle powder", "15 g Coriander, fresh", "15 ml Olive oil"]
instructions: Begin by preparing the corn husks; soak them in hot water for at least 30 minutes to make them pliable, then drain and pat them dry. Next, poach the chicken breast in lightly salted water for about 15-20 minutes until it is cooked through. Remove the chicken, allow it to cool slightly, and then finely shred it. In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the diced yellow onion until it becomes translucent, which takes about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and diced poblano pepper, continuing to cook for another 5 minutes until the vegetables have softened. Stir in the tomato paste, ground cumin, smoked paprika, and chipotle powder, cooking for just 1 minute until the spices are fragrant. Incorporate the shredded chicken and the drained black beans into the mixture, mixing everything well. If the filling appears too dry, add a small splash of chicken broth. Stir in the fresh chopped coriander and season the filling with salt and pepper to taste, then remove it from the heat. To prepare the masa, whisk together the masa harina, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. In a separate bowl, melt the coconut oil and gradually whisk in the warm chicken broth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix thoroughly, either by hand or using a stand mixer, for about 5-7 minutes until a soft, uniform, and fluffy dough forms. To assemble the tamales, take a softened corn husk with the wider end at the top. Spread about 2-3 tablespoons of the masa dough evenly over the wider part of the husk, ensuring you leave about 2-3 cm clear on the sides and bottom. Place about 1-2 tablespoons of the chicken and black bean filling down the center of the masa. Fold one side of the husk over the filling, then fold the other side over to create a cylinder. Fold the narrow end of the husk up towards the center. Arrange the assembled tamales upright with the folded end down in a steamer basket, making sure they are not packed too tightly to allow for proper steam circulation. Add about 2-3 cm of water to the bottom of the steamer pot, bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and steam for 45-60 minutes, or until the masa easily pulls away from the corn husk. Carefully remove the tamales from the steamer and let them rest for 5-10 minutes before unwrapping and serving.

title: Healthy Chicken and Black Bean Tamales with Poblano

title: Lean Turkey & Broccoli Tater Tot Casserole

title: Black Bean and Roasted Corn Tostadas with Avocado Crema

title: Lean Turkey & Black Bean Tostadas with Avocado Crema

title: Spicy Black Bean and Avocado Tostadas with Chipotle Crema

Pour the dressing over the tuna and vegetable mixture, tossing gently to ensure everything is evenly coated. Serve the salad immediately on a bed of fresh mixed green leaves, or chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld before serving.

title: Mediterranean Tuna Salad with Chickpeas and Lemon-Herb Dressing
ingredients_json: ["320 g Tuna, canned in water, drained", "240 g Chickpeas, canned, drained", "150 g Cucumber, raw", "200 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "50 g Onion, red, raw", "100 g Bell pepper, yellow, raw", "30 g Olives, Kalamata", "15 g Parsley, fresh", "30 ml Lemon juice, raw", "30 ml Olive oil", "5 g Mustard, Dijon", "0.5 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Drain and rinse the canned tuna and chickpeas thoroughly under cold water to reduce sodium content. Flake the tuna into a large mixing bowl. Add the rinsed chickpeas to the bowl. Dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, finely slice the red onion, and chop the yellow bell pepper. Add all the prepared vegetables to the bowl with the tuna and chickpeas. Roughly chop the fresh parsley and add it to the mixture. In a small separate bowl, whisk together the fresh lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper to create the dressing. Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss gently until everything is well combined and coated. Serve immediately or chill for a short period before serving to allow the flavors to meld.

title: Mediterranean Tuna & Quinoa Salad with Lemon Herb Dressing
ingredients_json: ["280 g Tuna, canned in water, drained", "100 g Quinoa, uncooked", "150 g Cucumber, fresh", "150 g Cherry tomatoes, fresh", "50 g Red onion, raw", "100 g Celery, raw", "100 g Yellow bell pepper, raw", "15 g Parsley, fresh", "10 g Dill, fresh", "30 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "30 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "10 g Dijon mustard", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "100 g Mixed salad leaves"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly under cold water, then cook it according to package instructions. Typically, combine 100g quinoa with 200ml water in a small pot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until all water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and let it cool. While the quinoa cooks, prepare the vegetables. Dice the cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, celery, and yellow bell pepper into small, bite-sized pieces. Finely chop the fresh parsley and dill. In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and ground black pepper to create the dressing. Once the quinoa has cooled, transfer it to a large mixing bowl. Add the drained tuna, all the diced vegetables, and the chopped fresh herbs. Pour the lemon herb dressing over the salad ingredients and gently toss to combine everything evenly. Serve the Mediterranean Tuna & Quinoa Salad over a bed of fresh mixed salad leaves.

title: Spiced Turkey Mince with Quinoa and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["300 g Turkey mince, lean", "150 g Quinoa, uncooked", "400 ml Vegetable stock, low sodium", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "1 piece Red bell pepper", "200 g Broccoli florets", "100 g Cherry tomatoes", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "1 tsp Paprika, ground", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). In a large bowl, toss the broccoli florets and chopped red bell pepper with 0.5 tbsp of the olive oil, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on a baking tray and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until they are tender-crisp. Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa thoroughly under cold water using a fine-mesh sieve. Combine the rinsed quinoa with the vegetable stock in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the quinoa is fluffy. While the vegetables roast and quinoa cooks, heat the remaining 0.5 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until it softens and becomes translucent. Add the turkey mince to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon, and cook until it is completely browned, which usually takes about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat if necessary. Stir in the ground cumin, paprika, and garlic powder, cooking for another minute until the spices are fragrant. Season the turkey mince with the remaining salt and black pepper. Remove the pan from the heat. Once the other vegetables are roasted, add the cherry tomatoes to the baking tray and toss gently with the hot roasted vegetables to warm them through for the last 5 minutes of roasting, or simply serve them fresh alongside the hot dish. To serve, divide the cooked quinoa among two plates, top with the spiced turkey mince, and arrange the roasted vegetables and cherry tomatoes alongside.

title: Turkey Meatballs with Whole Wheat Spaghetti and Rich Tomato Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Ground turkey, lean", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "30 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat", "1 g Oregano, dried", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt, table", "30 ml Olive oil", "150 g Onion, raw", "6 g Garlic clove, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "400 g Canned crushed tomatoes", "100 ml Vegetable stock", "250 g Spaghetti, whole wheat", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "3 g Salt, table"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground turkey, egg, whole wheat breadcrumbs, 1 gram of dried oregano, 0.5 grams of black pepper, and 3 grams of salt. Mix thoroughly by hand until just combined, then roll the mixture into approximately 16-18 meatballs. Heat 15 ml of olive oil in a large pot or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the meatballs on all sides, then remove them from the pot and set aside. In the same pot, add the remaining 15 ml of olive oil. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and chopped red bell pepper, cooking for another 3-4 minutes until the pepper begins to soften. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and vegetable stock, along with 1 gram of dried basil. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer. Carefully add the browned turkey meatballs back into the sauce. Reduce heat to low, cover, and let simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the meatballs are cooked through. While the sauce simmers, cook the whole wheat spaghetti according to package directions in a separate pot of salted boiling water until al dente. Drain well. Stir the fresh spinach into the simmering sauce with the meatballs until it wilts, which should only take a couple of minutes. Season the sauce with the remaining 3 grams of salt to taste. Serve the turkey meatballs and sauce over the cooked whole wheat spaghetti.

title: Lean Ground Turkey and Vegetable Stir-fry with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g Ground turkey, lean (5% fat)", "200 g Brown rice, uncooked", "4 dl Water, for rice", "300 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "200 g Red bell pepper, fresh", "60 g Carrot, fresh", "150 g Onion, fresh", "6 g Garlic, fresh", "10 g Ginger, fresh", "30 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "15 ml Rice vinegar", "5 ml Sesame oil, toasted", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Salt, fine"]
instructions: First, rinse the brown rice thoroughly under cold water. Combine the rinsed rice with 4 dl of water in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 40-45 minutes, or until all water is absorbed and rice is tender. Let it rest, covered, for 10 minutes before fluffing with a fork. While the rice cooks, prepare the vegetables. Chop the onion and red bell pepper into bite-sized pieces. Slice the carrot into thin rounds or julienne strips. Mince the garlic and grate the fresh ginger. Cut the broccoli into small florets. Heat the olive oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the lean ground turkey and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until it is browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess liquid if necessary, then remove the turkey from the skillet and set aside. Add the chopped onion, carrots, and bell pepper to the same skillet. Stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until the vegetables start to soften slightly but are still crisp. Add the broccoli florets, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the skillet. Continue to stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes, until the broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp. Return the cooked turkey to the skillet with the vegetables. Pour in the low-sodium soy sauce and rice vinegar, and drizzle with sesame oil. Stir everything together well to coat the turkey and vegetables evenly. Season with a pinch of black pepper and salt, if needed. Serve the hot turkey and vegetable stir-fry immediately over the fluffy brown rice.

title: Lean Turkey & Bell Pepper Quinoa Skillet
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean, raw", "200 g Quinoa, dry", "15 ml Olive oil", "150 g Onion, yellow, raw", "10 g Garlic, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, yellow, raw", "200 g Zucchini, raw", "400 g Tomatoes, diced, canned", "400 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "5 g Cumin, ground", "5 g Paprika, ground", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly under cold water, then cook it according to package instructions until light and fluffy. While the quinoa cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet or pan over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened. Mince the garlic and add it to the pan, cooking for another minute until fragrant. Add the lean turkey mince to the skillet, breaking it apart with a spoon, and cook until it is browned all over, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat if necessary. Dice the bell peppers and zucchini, then add them to the skillet with the browned turkey. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables start to soften. Stir in the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, ground cumin, ground paprika, salt, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and let it cook for 10-15 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the vegetables to become tender. Stir in the fresh chopped parsley just before serving. Serve the turkey and vegetable skillet over the cooked quinoa.

title: Sheet Pan Mediterranean Turkey and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "2 pieces Bell pepper, red", "1 piece Bell pepper, yellow", "1 piece Courgette", "1 piece Red onion", "250 g Cherry tomatoes", "30 ml Olive oil", "3 cloves Garlic", "5 g Dried oregano", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "10 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Chop the bell peppers, courgette, and red onion into bite-sized pieces. Mince the garlic cloves. In a large bowl, combine the turkey mince, chopped bell peppers, courgette, red onion, cherry tomatoes, minced garlic, olive oil, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper. Mix everything thoroughly with your hands until well combined. Spread the mixture evenly in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the turkey is cooked through and the vegetables are tender-crisp. Remove from the oven, drizzle with fresh lemon juice, and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

title: Baked Lean Turkey and Mediterranean Veggie Ziti
ingredients_json: ["250 g Ziti pasta, whole wheat, uncooked", "500 g Ground turkey, lean (93% fat-free)", "15 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "150 g Onion, yellow, raw", "15 g Garlic, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "200 g Zucchini, raw", "800 g Canned crushed tomatoes, unsalted", "100 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "5 g Dried oregano", "5 g Dried basil", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "1 piece Egg, raw, large", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, part-skim, shredded", "20 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius (375 degrees Fahrenheit). Cook the whole wheat ziti according to package directions until al dente; drain and set aside. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the lean ground turkey and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned throughout. Drain any excess fat. Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, diced red bell pepper, and sliced zucchini to the skillet with the turkey. Sauté for 8-10 minutes, or until the vegetables have softened. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth, then stir in the dried oregano, dried basil, salt, and black pepper. Bring the sauce to a simmer and let it cook for about 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld, stirring occasionally. Stir in the fresh spinach until it wilts into the sauce. In a separate bowl, combine the part-skim ricotta cheese with the raw egg, mixing well. Add the cooked ziti pasta to the sauce in the skillet, tossing gently to combine all ingredients evenly. Spread half of the ziti mixture into the bottom of the skillet. Dollop the ricotta mixture over the ziti, then top with half of the shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese. Add the remaining ziti mixture, spreading it out evenly, and then sprinkle the rest of the mozzarella and the grated Parmesan cheese over the top. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the casserole is heated through. Let it rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Chicken and Spinach Ziti with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["400 g Ziti pasta, whole wheat", "400 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "15 ml Olive oil", "150 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "10 g Garlic, raw, minced", "180 g Red bell pepper, raw, diced", "200 g Zucchini, raw, diced", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "700 g Tomato sauce, low sodium", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, low-fat, shredded", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "5 g Dried oregano", "5 g Dried basil", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Cook the ziti pasta according to package directions until al dente, then drain and set aside. While the pasta cooks, dice the chicken breast into 1-inch pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced chicken and cook until lightly browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. In the same skillet, add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Add the minced garlic along with the diced red bell pepper and zucchini, cooking for another 5-7 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the fresh spinach until it wilts completely. Add the tomato sauce, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, bringing the mixture to a simmer. Return the cooked chicken to the sauce, then add the drained ziti pasta, tossing everything to combine evenly. Transfer half of the pasta mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with half of the low-fat mozzarella cheese. Top with the remaining pasta mixture and then sprinkle with the rest of the mozzarella and the grated Parmesan cheese. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the dish is heated through. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Hearty Baked Chicken and Vegetable Ziti with Whole Wheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["400 g Whole wheat ziti pasta, dry", "500 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "700 g Tomato passata, unsalted", "1 piece Onion, yellow, large", "4 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 pieces Bell pepper, red", "2 pieces Bell pepper, yellow", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "2 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "200 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, part-skim, shredded", "2 tsp Italian seasoning, dried", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius (400 degrees Fahrenheit). Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook the whole wheat ziti pasta according to package directions until al dente, then drain it thoroughly and set aside. While the pasta cooks, finely dice the onion and mince the garlic. Slice the bell peppers into thin strips. Cut the chicken breast into 1-inch cubes. Heat one tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the chicken cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes; remove the chicken from the skillet and set it aside. Add the remaining tablespoon of olive oil to the same skillet, then add the diced onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and sliced bell peppers, cooking for another 5 minutes until the peppers begin to soften. Pour in the tomato passata and vegetable broth, add the Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low, return the cooked chicken to the skillet, and let it simmer for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook until it wilts, about 2-3 minutes. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked ziti pasta with the chicken and vegetable sauce. Add the part-skim ricotta cheese and half of the shredded mozzarella cheese, mixing well to combine all ingredients. Transfer the entire mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining shredded mozzarella cheese and the grated Parmesan cheese evenly over the top. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the sauce is heated through. Let the ziti rest for 5-10 minutes before serving to allow it to set.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Spinach Ziti Bake
ingredients_json: ["300 g Ziti pasta, whole wheat, dry", "500 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 unit Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "400 g Tomatoes, canned, crushed", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, light, shredded", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 dl Vegetable broth", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Dried basil", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Cook the whole wheat ziti pasta according to package directions until al dente; drain and set aside. While the pasta cooks, dice the chicken breast into 2 cm cubes. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove chicken from the pan and set aside. Add the chopped onion and diced red bell pepper to the same skillet and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth, then add the dried oregano and basil. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then return the cooked chicken to the pan. Stir in the fresh spinach a handful at a time, allowing it to wilt into the sauce. Season the sauce with salt and black pepper. In a large baking dish, combine the cooked ziti pasta with the chicken and vegetable sauce, ensuring everything is well mixed. Sprinkle the light mozzarella cheese and grated Parmesan cheese evenly over the top of the ziti. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the casserole is heated through. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Fluffy Lemon Angel Food Cake
ingredients_json: ["360 g Egg white, raw", "220 g Sugar, white, granulated", "110 g Wheat flour, cake", "6 g Cream of tartar", "7.5 ml Vanilla extract", "3 g Salt", "1 piece Lemon, zest of"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C (350°F) and position a rack in the lower third. Do not grease an angel food cake pan; it needs the batter to cling to the sides for climbing. In a medium bowl, sift together the cake flour and 100 g of the granulated sugar; set aside. In a very large, clean mixing bowl, using an electric mixer, beat the egg whites, cream of tartar, and salt on medium speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add the remaining 120 g of granulated sugar, about one tablespoon at a time, continuing to beat on high speed until stiff, glossy peaks form. Gently fold in the vanilla extract and lemon zest until just combined. Sift about one-third of the flour mixture over the egg white mixture and gently fold it in with a rubber spatula, taking care not to deflate the whites. Repeat with the remaining flour mixture in two additions, folding until no streaks of flour remain. Pour the batter into the ungreased angel food cake pan and gently smooth the top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the cake is golden brown and springs back when lightly touched. Immediately invert the pan onto its 'feet' (or over the neck of a bottle if your pan doesn't have feet) and let it cool completely for at least 1.5 to 2 hours before running a thin knife around the edges to release the cake.

title: Light Lemon Raspberry Angel Food Cake
ingredients_json: ["360 g Egg white, raw", "200 g Sugar, granulated, white", "90 g Wheat flour, cake", "5 g Cream of tartar", "2 g Salt, table", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "10 g Lemon zest, fresh", "200 g Raspberries, fresh", "10 g Sugar, powdered"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C. Do not grease a 25 cm (10-inch) tube pan with a removable bottom, as the batter needs to cling to the sides to rise properly. In a medium bowl, whisk together the 90 g of cake flour and 75 g of granulated sugar until well combined, then set this mixture aside. In a large, very clean bowl (it's crucial that it's grease-free for the egg whites to whip properly), add the 360 g of egg whites, 5 g of cream of tartar, and 2 g of salt. Beat with an electric mixer on medium-high speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add the remaining 125 g of granulated sugar, one tablespoon at a time, continuing to beat until stiff, glossy peaks form and the meringue looks firm and holds its shape. Gently fold in the 5 ml of vanilla extract and 10 g of lemon zest using a rubber spatula. Sift about a quarter of the flour and sugar mixture over the meringue and gently fold it in, being careful not to deflate the egg whites. Repeat this process with the remaining flour mixture in three more additions until everything is just combined and no streaks of flour remain. Carefully spoon the batter into the ungreased tube pan and smooth the top. Lightly swirl in half of the 200 g fresh raspberries if you wish, or reserve them all for garnish. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the cake is golden brown, springs back when lightly touched, and makes a rustling sound when pressed. Immediately invert the pan onto the bottle neck or onto its specific feet if your pan has them, and let it cool completely, for at least 1 hour, or until it is entirely cool. This step is essential to prevent the cake from collapsing. Once cooled, run a thin knife around the edges of the pan and the inner core to release the cake. Carefully remove the cake from the pan. Dust with the 10 g of powdered sugar and serve with the remaining fresh raspberries.

title: Light Lemon Vanilla Angel Food Cake
ingredients_json: ["360 g Egg white, raw", "150 g Granulated sugar", "90 g Cake flour, sifted", "1.5 tsp Cream of tartar", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "0.5 tsp Salt", "Zest of 1 lemon"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 170°C (325°F). Make sure your tube pan (25 cm with a removable bottom) is perfectly clean and ungreased, as any grease will prevent the cake from rising. In a medium bowl, sift together the cake flour and 75 grams of the granulated sugar; set aside. In a large, very clean mixing bowl, beat the egg whites with the cream of tartar and salt on medium speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add the remaining 75 grams of granulated sugar, one tablespoon at a time, continuing to beat on high speed until stiff, glossy peaks form. Gently fold in the vanilla extract and lemon zest. Slowly and carefully, fold the sifted flour and sugar mixture into the egg white mixture, about a quarter at a time, until just combined, being careful not to deflate the whites. Pour the batter evenly into the ungreased tube pan. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and springs back when lightly touched. Invert the pan immediately onto its feet or over the neck of a bottle and let it cool completely upside down for at least 1.5 hours before running a thin knife around the edges and removing the cake from the pan.

title: Light and Fluffy Lemon Berry Angel Food Cake
ingredients_json: ["360 g Egg white, raw", "180 g Caster sugar, white", "90 g Wheat flour, plain, sifted", "5 ml Cream of tartar", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "1 g Salt, fine table", "5 g Lemon, raw, zest", "100 g Strawberry, fresh, whole", "50 g Blueberry, fresh", "50 g Raspberry, fresh", "15 g Powdered sugar"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C (350°F). Sift the flour, 75g of the caster sugar, and salt together into a bowl and set aside. In a large, very clean bowl, beat the egg whites with the cream of tartar and lemon zest on medium speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add the remaining 105g of caster sugar, one tablespoon at a time, continuing to beat until stiff, glossy peaks form. Gently fold in the vanilla extract. Carefully fold the sifted dry ingredients into the egg white mixture in three additions, being careful not to deflate the whites. Pour the batter into an ungreased 25 cm (10-inch) tube pan. Smooth the top and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the cake springs back when lightly touched and is golden brown. Invert the pan immediately over the neck of a bottle or onto the pan's feet if it has them, and let it cool completely, for at least 1.5 to 2 hours. Once cooled, run a thin knife around the edges and center tube to release the cake. For the topping, gently mix the fresh strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries in a small bowl. If desired, you can sprinkle a little of the powdered sugar over the berries for extra sweetness. Slice the angel food cake and serve with the fresh berry mixture.

title: Light Lemon Berry Angel Food Cake
ingredients_json: ["360 g Egg white, raw", "280 g Sugar, white, granulated", "90 g Flour, wheat, white, cake", "8 g Cream of tartar", "2 g Salt", "10 ml Vanilla extract", "1 piece Lemon, zest of", "200 g Strawberry, raw", "150 g Blueberry, raw", "150 g Raspberry, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 170°C (325°F). Make sure your angel food cake pan (tube pan with removable bottom, 25 cm) is clean and completely grease-free. Sift the cake flour together with 100 grams of the granulated sugar three times to ensure it's very light and airy, then set aside. In a large, very clean mixing bowl, using an electric mixer, beat the egg whites on medium speed until foamy. Add the cream of tartar and salt, then increase speed to medium-high and continue beating until soft peaks form. Gradually add the remaining 180 grams of granulated sugar, one tablespoon at a time, beating until stiff, glossy peaks form and the sugar is fully dissolved. Beat in the vanilla extract and lemon zest. Gently fold in the sifted flour mixture, about a quarter at a time, being careful not to deflate the egg whites. Pour the batter into the ungreased tube pan, spreading it evenly. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the cake is golden brown and springs back when lightly touched. Immediately invert the pan onto its feet (or onto the neck of a bottle if your pan doesn't have feet) and let it hang upside down for at least 1.5 to 2 hours, or until completely cool. This prevents the cake from collapsing. Once cooled, run a thin knife around the edges and center tube to release the cake. Slice and serve with the fresh mixed berries.

title: Wholesome Spiced Apple Pie with Whole Wheat Crust
ingredients_json: ["250 g Flour, whole wheat", "100 g Butter, unsalted, cold, cubed", "50 ml Water, ice cold", "5 g Sugar, granulated", "2 g Salt, table", "1.2 kg Apple, fresh, unpeeled, cored, sliced", "50 g Maple syrup", "10 g Cornstarch", "5 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "2 g Nutmeg, ground", "1 g Vanilla extract", "5 g Butter, unsalted", "1 piece Egg, raw"]
instructions: Start by preparing the pie crust. In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, sugar, and salt. Add the cold, cubed unsalted butter and cut it into the flour mixture using a pastry blender or your fingertips until it resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually add the ice-cold water, one tablespoon at a time, mixing until the dough just comes together. Be careful not to overmix. Divide the dough into two equal portions, flatten each into a disc, wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the apple filling. In a large bowl, combine the sliced apples, maple syrup, cornstarch, fresh lemon juice, ground cinnamon, and ground nutmeg. Stir gently to ensure all apples are coated. Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). On a lightly floured surface, roll out one disc of dough into a 30 cm (12 inch) circle. Carefully transfer it to a 23 cm (9 inch) pie plate, trimming any excess dough. Pour the apple filling into the crust and dot with small pieces of butter. Roll out the second disc of dough and place it over the filling. Trim the top crust, leaving about 2 cm (0.8 inches) overhang, then fold the top crust under the bottom crust and crimp the edges to seal. Cut several slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape. Beat the raw egg and brush it over the top crust. Bake for 15 minutes at 200°C (390°F), then reduce the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and continue baking for another 40-50 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbly. If the crust browns too quickly, cover the edges loosely with foil. Let the pie cool completely on a wire rack for at least 2-3 hours before serving, allowing the filling to set.

title: Healthy Spiced Apple Pie with Whole Wheat Crust
ingredients_json: ["300 g Flour, whole wheat, unspecified", "150 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "5 g Salt, table", "100 ml Water, ice cold", "1.5 kg Apple, Granny Smith, raw", "50 g Sugar, brown, light", "10 g Corn starch", "10 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "5 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 g Nutmeg, ground"]
instructions: First, prepare the pie crust: In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour and salt. Cut the cold unsalted butter into small cubes and add to the flour mixture. Using your fingertips or a pastry blender, work the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces of butter remaining. Gradually add the ice-cold water, one tablespoon at a time, mixing until the dough just comes together. Be careful not to overmix. Divide the dough into two balls, one slightly larger than the other, flatten them into discs, wrap in plastic film, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. title: Vanilla Bean Creme Brulee with Lighter Custard
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "0.5 dl Cream, light, 20% fat", "4 piece Egg yolk, raw", "50 g Sugar, white, granulated", "1 piece Vanilla bean, raw", "20 g Sugar, white, granulated"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 150°C (300°F). Split the vanilla bean lengthwise and scrape out the seeds. In a medium saucepan, combine the semi-skimmed milk, light cream, vanilla bean pod, and vanilla seeds. Heat over medium-low heat until the mixture is simmering gently, but do not boil. Remove from heat and let steep for 15 minutes to infuse the vanilla flavor, then remove the vanilla bean pod. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks and 50g of granulated sugar until light and creamy. Gradually temper the warm milk mixture into the egg yolk mixture, whisking constantly to prevent the eggs from scrambling. Strain the custard through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl to ensure a smooth texture, removing any remaining vanilla bean pieces or cooked egg. Pour the custard into four 1.5 dl (5 oz) ramekins. Place the ramekins in a larger baking dish and fill the baking dish with hot water until it reaches about halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Carefully transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly when gently shaken. Carefully remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool completely on a wire rack. Once cooled, refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, until thoroughly chilled. Just before serving, sprinkle an even layer of the remaining 20g of granulated sugar over the top of each chilled custard. Using a kitchen torch, caramelize the sugar until it forms a crisp, amber-colored crust. Alternatively, place under a broiler for a few minutes, watching carefully to prevent burning. Let sit for a minute or two to allow the sugar to harden before serving.

title: Light Vanilla Bean Flan with Reduced Sugar
ingredients_json: ["30 g White sugar (for caramel)", "4 dl Milk, semi-skimmed (1.5% fat)", "3 pieces Egg, raw, whole", "2 pieces Egg yolk, raw", "40 g White sugar (for custard)", "5 ml Vanilla extract"]
instructions: First, prepare the caramel. In a small saucepan, combine 30g of white sugar with 1 tablespoon of water. Heat over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally until the sugar dissolves. Increase the heat to medium and cook without stirring until the sugar turns into a golden amber caramel. Be careful not to burn it. Immediately pour the hot caramel into a 1-liter oven-safe flan mold, tilting the mold to coat the bottom evenly. Set aside to cool and harden. Next, preheat your oven to 160°C (320°F) and boil water for a water bath. In a large bowl, whisk together the semi-skimmed milk, whole eggs, egg yolks, 40g of white sugar, and vanilla extract until well combined and the sugar is dissolved. Strain the custard mixture through a fine-mesh sieve to ensure a smooth texture, removing any chalazae or foam. Carefully pour the strained custard into the caramel-lined flan mold. Place the flan mold inside a larger baking dish. Pour the hot water into the larger baking dish until it reaches about halfway up the sides of the flan mold. Carefully transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake for 50-60 minutes, or until the flan is just set but still slightly wobbly in the center. A knife inserted near the edge should come out clean. Remove the flan from the oven and carefully take it out of the water bath. Let it cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, to chill thoroughly. To serve, run a thin knife around the edge of the flan to loosen it. Place a serving plate upside down over the mold and, holding both firmly together, quickly invert them. The flan should slide out, releasing the caramel over the top.

title: Vanilla Bean Almond Flan with Date Caramel

In a large bowl, whisk together the whole eggs and egg yolks until just combined, being careful not to create too many bubbles. In a separate saucepan, gently heat the unsweetened almond drink, maple syrup, erythritol, vanilla extract, and the scraped seeds from half a vanilla bean until warm but not boiling, stirring until the sweeteners are dissolved. title: Light Vanilla Bean Flan with Berries

title: Lightened Vanilla Bean Skim Milk Flan

ingredients_json: ["200 g Coconut, shredded, unsweetened", "30 g Almond flour", "50 g Sugar, granulated", "2 piece Egg white, raw", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "1 piece Lemon, zest", "1 g Salt, table"]

title: Healthy Coconut Almond Macaroons with a Hint of Lemon
ingredients_json: ["150 g Almond flour, blanched", "100 g Coconut flakes, unsweetened", "3 pieces Egg white, raw", "50 g Erythritol, powdered sweetener", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "1 zest Lemon, fresh", "20 g Dark chocolate, 70-85% cocoa solids"]

Gradually add the powdered erythritol and continue whisking until stiff, glossy peaks are achieved, similar to a meringue. Gently fold the dry ingredient mixture into the whipped egg whites in three additions, being careful not to deflate the egg whites too much. Once combined, stir in the vanilla extract. title: Healthy Coconut Almond Macaroons with Dark Chocolate Drizzle

Gradually add the dry coconut-almond mixture to the egg white mixture, folding carefully until just incorporated. Be careful not to overmix. Using a spoon or a small ice cream scoop, drop spoonfuls of the macaroon mixture onto the prepared baking tray, shaping them into small, compact mounds. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the macaroons are lightly golden brown at the edges and set. Once baked, remove the tray from the oven and let the macaroons cool completely on the parchment paper. While they cool, melt the dark chocolate using a double boiler or in a microwave-safe bowl in short bursts, stirring until smooth. Drizzle the melted chocolate over the cooled macaroons. Allow the chocolate to set completely at room temperature or in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Zesty Almond Coconut Macaroons (Low Sugar)
ingredients_json: ["150 g Coconut, desiccated", "50 g Almond flour, blanched", "3 piece Egg white, raw", "60 g Erythritol, granular", "5 g Lemon zest, fresh (from 1 small lemon)", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "1 g Salt, table"]
